articleTitle: AI Based Native Food Nutrition Prescribing Chatbot
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Several studies on the advantage of eating mindfully have concentrated on the idea that maintaining a healthy diet can aid people in preventing the onset of chronic illness including cancer, diabetes, and obesity. It is time-consuming to learn the nutritional worth and contents of each item we eat on a regular basis. So, we require a "Intelligent Chat Bot" that uses artificial intelligence to respond to queries about food's nutritional information and other healthier substitutes. It makes use of algorithms and information databases to comprehend user input and produce responses about diet and nutrition. Natural language comprehension techniques form the basis of the chatbot, but voice synthesis and recognition are also crucial for the achievement of the agent's interactions. This Chabot offers the user the nutritional information for the foods we consume every day, together with recommendations for local food options from the closest market, and also safe chat history storage for future users' input.

articleTitle: Broad Beamforming Technology In 5G Massive MIMO
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Massive MIMO (multiple input multiple output) technology plays a key role in many 5G networks today, boosting throughput and capacity by enabling user-specific beamforming of the data channel. For applications that require broad beams for large antenna arrays – broadcast and control signaling. Broad beamforming is a key component of 5G Massive MIMO, as it enables efficient and reliable communication with a large number of user devices in a variety of scenarios. It helps 5G networks deliver better coverage and capacity, especially in dynamic and challenging environments, making it a critical technology for the deployment of 5G services. Broad beamforming aims to create wider beams that cover a larger area and may not require as precise alignment. Combining broad beamforming technology with the Dual Polarized Beamforming (DPBF) technique in 5G Massive MIMO systems offers a powerful solution for adapting to changing user positions and channel conditions in dynamic environments. This approach provides flexibility in steering beams in both horizontal and vertical directions, improving the coverage and adaptability of the network. It's especially valuable in scenarios where user devices have varying polarization characteristics or when interference management is critical for optimal performance.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Based Framework for Predicting Overall Survival in Chordoma Patients
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: The purpose of this research was to compare the traditional Cox proportional hazards (CoxPH) model with machine learning (ML) approaches in predicting chordoma patients' survival rates. We developed and tested three machine learning survival-models in addition to a classic CoxPH model. The dataset was split into two parts, one for training and one for validation, at random. With fivefold cross-validation and a thousand iterations of random searching, the training dataset's hyperparameters were fine-tuned. We used the Brier score, integrated Brier score, and Concordance-index(C-index) to measure the model's accuracy. To determine the accuracy, we projected 5-&10-year survival probability using the area under the AUC, calibration-curves, and receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curves. Collecting data from 724 chordoma patients, 508 were assigned to the training cohort and 216 to the validation cohort. Nine prognostic indicators were found to be significant (p < 0.05) by Cox regression. With a C-index of 0.795 and AUCs of 0.84 and 0.88 for 5- and 10-year survival, respectively, ML models outperformed the CoxPH model. DeepSurv was the most effective model. The calibration curves showed that DeepSurv's predictions and real survival rates were highly correlated. High-and low-risk groups were successfully distinguished using the DeepSurv model for risk stratification (p < 0.01). In summary DeepSurv has the finest discernment performance and tuning among ML-strategies based on time-to-event outcomes, and it is effective in chordoma prediction.

articleTitle: Dynamically Adaptive GPS Antenna with Enhanced Position Accuracy for IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: A novel approach to GPS antenna design (1.575 GHz) by incorporating artificial intelligence (AI) techniques to dynamically adjust its reception pattern and enhancing positioning accuracy with 3 dBi gain is presented. The proposed antenna consists of 70% efficiency with -17 dB return loss and it aims to optimize positioning accuracy by adapting to evolving signal requirements and newly identified user specifications. Through the integration of machine learning algorithms, the antenna adjusts its reception pattern based on dynamic data inputs, ensuring optimal signal strength and quality in response to various signal parameters and refined user requirements. This integration of AI-driven GPS antenna design is pivotal for diverse IoT applications, emphasizing the critical role of GPS in enabling seamless operations reliant on precise location-based functionalities.

articleTitle: Enhanced Binary Waterwheel Plant Optimization with Fuzzy Decision Tree for Intrusion Detection in Cloud Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: In the era of cloud computing, ensuring robust security measures against cyber threats is paramount. This paper introduces an advanced intrusion detection system (IDS) that uses an Enhanced binary Waterwheel Plant Optimization (Eb-WPO) algorithm combined with a Fuzzy Decision Tree (FDT) for improved detection accuracy and efficiency. The proposed Eb-WPO algorithm incorporates adaptive parameter tuning and mutation techniques to effectively balance exploration and exploitation, enhancing the optimization process. This algorithm optimizes the feature selection process, which is crucial for the Fuzzy Decision Tree's performance. The FDT is utilized for its ability to handle uncertainty and imprecision in data, making it an ideal choice for Intrusion Detection in dynamic cloud environments. The hybrid IDS is tested on various benchmark datasets, demonstrating significant improvements in detection rates and reduced false positives compared to traditional methods. The results highlight the system's potential for real-time application in securing cloud infrastructure against sophisticated cyber-attacks.

articleTitle: EEFO Based Frequency Control of Islanded Microgird
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: This research paper investigates a novel control design for the frequency control of Islanded Microgrid driven, equipped with diesel based generator engine, Wind and the Solar power without some energy storage devices. Fluctuations in frequency is being occurred due to the power consumption of (heat pump, freezer) non critical loads as well as plug in electric vehicle with its charging and discharging process. To investigate the performance metrix of Islanded Microgrid several step load disturbances conditions are included in wind, solar and load. Controller parameters are optimized by novel applications of Electric Eel’s Foraging Optimization (EEFO) technique along with the most popular Particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm. Simulation results disclose that the EEFO optimized controller outperforms the other controllers in all aspects of performed disturbances.

articleTitle: WeatherSphere: Redefining Weather Interaction through Augmented Reality
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: This research introduces a novel mobile application that employs augmented reality (AR) to enhance user engagement with weather information. By integrating Unreal Engine for advanced 3D visualization and React Native for cross-platform accessibility, the app creates immersive and interactive weather experiences. The developed application successfully transforms static weather data into dynamic, three-dimensional representations that users can directly interact with in their real-world environment. This AR-driven UI significantly improves user engagement and understanding of weather patterns. The findings of this study demonstrate the potential of AR to revolutionize weather app design. By prioritizing accessibility and user experience, the developed application offers a new paradigm for how individuals consume and interact with weather information. Future research could explore expanding AR features, integrating additional weather data, and conducting user studies to further refine the app's design.

articleTitle: Harnessing LSTM Networks for Enhanced Text Classification: A Comprehensive Study
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Text classification is an important natural language processing (NLP) technique that allows the user to turn unstructured data into structured data. Text classification enables various applications such as sentiment analysis, encompassing positive, negative, neutral, happy, sad, and review ratings, spam detection, and topic categorization. In addition to this , natural language processing is a field of artificial intelligence that develops machines that can understand human language, whether it be text or sound, and therefore can interact with individuals. Moreover, a huge amount of textual data is needed in the modern digital era, making computers automatically classify enormous amounts of data. Long-short-term memory is used in the research paper, which is a type of recurrent neural network that works very well with sequential data handling. Moreover, due to LSTM’s ability to capture context and long-term dependencies in sequential data, the research appears more significant. With further research, the paper delves deeper into deep learning, exploring the architecture, operation, and potential applications of LSTM. The results show a 78% accuracy, suggesting that LSTM-based models greatly advance text categorization and increase traditional techniques in terms of both robustness and accuracy.

articleTitle: Early Localized Lyme Disease prediction using Image Processing and Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: The purpose of this study is to predict the early Lyme disease with the set of images and applying few machine learning algorithms. For this dataset taken from the public medical image repositories such as DermNet NZ, HAPiD, etc., using this two Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) machine learning algorithms such as VGGNet and GoogLeNet. The dataset size predicted using gpower tool with eighty percent of sample setting. With the sample size prediction the CNN type of VGGNet and GoogLeNet both are iterated and the results are recorded using training and testing data. The results were such as accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and ROC-AUC are determined to predict early localized Lyme disease. It was found that the novel CNN VGGNet model achieved an accuracy of 96.84% and other performance metrics compared to the CNN GoogLeNet algorithm’s 91.34% for the Lyme disease dataset. Hence this research study can help the healthcare practitioners or experts to identify the early growth of Lyme also this study result accepted the statistical significant of p value of 0.001, which is less than 0.05 in the independent t-test on both the machine learning algorithms. Therefore, the results indicate that the CNN VGGNet machine learning algorithm proves useful for early Lyme disease prediction and is effective at recognizing skin lesions.

articleTitle: Design of Polymer Based Wearable Antenna for Biomedical Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Demand for flexible wearable antenna has increased in recent times. Various methods and design were proposed to minimize and improve the antenna performance based on gain, efficiency, S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</inf>. This article presents a flexible wearable antenna for biomedical applications resonating at 2.4-2.48 GHz. Designed antenna uses Polymer based flexible material polyimide (є<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</inf> = 3.5, loss tangent =0.0001) as substrate. Size of the antenna is 28 x 20 x 1 (all in mm). Patch is etched with rectangular slots and resonant frequency can be decreased by reducing the ground plane. Slot dimensions are varied to obtain the desired antenna design. The proposed antenna operates at 2.417 GHz with 2.03 dBi gain, 1.02 VSWR and 2.250 dBi directivity. 95% radiation efficiency is achieved by the proposed antenna. Specific Absorption Rate (SAR) is measured for two-layer phantom model with different air gaps and three-layer phantom model. SAR value obtained is well behind the maximum acceptable value for two- layer phantom model. CST studio is used for simulating the designed antenna and the simulation output shows that it can be a good option for wearable biomedical device.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cognitive Radio Network Performance through Channel Selection Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: In response to the historical challenge of allocation of spectrum causing scarcity in wireless networks, cognitive radio network technology has evolved as a solution It allows secondary users (SUs) to have dynamic spectrum access by requiring significant modifications to Medium Access Control (MAC) layer operations. In particular, these modifications are related to spectrum sensing and channel assignment, since MAC protocols are essential for arranging sensing intervals and reducing interference. In addressing the imperative for enhanced spectrum sensing accuracy, this research primarily focuses on the productive channel selection algorithm. This algorithm categorizes channels based on descreasing idling probabilities, facilitating swift channel discovery and concurrent sensing. This approach effectively reduces latency and maximizes throughput for SUs. The proposed Extended Generalised Predictive Channel Selection Algorithm has been demonstrated to outperform its predecessor, the Generalised Predictive Channel Selection Algorithm, as showcased through comprehensive Matlab simulations and results visualization.

articleTitle: Enhancing Heart Disease Model Accuracy: A Study of Optimization Hyperparameter Tuning Techniques in Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Heart disease (HD) is a major global health issue, This study evaluates Machine learning (ML) models such as Logistic Regression (LR), Decision Tree (DT), K- Nearest Neighbors (KNN), and Support Vector Machine (SVM) for heart disease dataset using Train-Test Split(TTS) and K-Fold Cross-Validation (KF-CV). Initially, accuracy rates improved with KF-CV across all models. The DT model achieved 98.54 percent accuracy with TTS and 99.32 percent with KF-CV in the pre-optimization phase. To further enhance accuracy, four advanced optimization techniques—Grid Search CV, Random Search CV, Ant Colony Optimization (ACO), and Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) were applied. The findings revealed that the DT model achieved perfect score of 100 percent accuracy with Grid Search CV and Random Search CV. SVM and KNN models also showed significant improvements with advanced tuning. PSO, in particular, was effective for optimizing hyperparameters of the LR model. This study underscores the value of advanced optimization techniques in improving the accuracy of heart disease prediction models.

articleTitle: A Novel Segmentation of MRI Brain Tumor using Red Fox Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Background: Brain tumors are abnormal growths of tissue within the brain and are associated with a high mortality rate, with most patients dying within 9 to 12 months and less than 3% surviving beyond 3 years. Early and effective detection is crucial for improving survival rates. One of the critical tasks in medical image processing is the segmentation of brain tumors from MRI images, a process that is challenging to perform manually due to the large volume of data generated during clinical procedures.Methods: The proposed method aims to automate brain tumor segmentation using a hybrid approach involving red fox optimization (RFO), OTSU image segmentation, and Expectation Maximization. Initially, MRI images are denoised using various filters such as bilateral, mean, morphological, and wiener filters. The morphological filter, which demonstrated superior performance, is then selected for further processing. Subsequently, the segmentation is optimized using Red Fox Optimization and the tumor is segmented using OTSU segmentation.Results: The denoising process using various filters was evaluated, and the morphological filter was found to outperform the others in terms of SNR and PSNR values. This filter was consequently used in the subsequent steps of the segmentation process. The application of Red Fox Optimization and OTSU segmentation resulted in the effective isolation of tumors from the MRI images, demonstrating the potential for this hybrid method to facilitate early detection of brain tumors.Conclusion: The hybrid method combining red fox optimization, OTSU segmentation, and Expectation Maximization presents a viable approach for the automated segmentation of brain tumors from MRI images. The superior performance of the morphological filter in the denoising process, coupled with the effective optimization and segmentation techniques, underscores the potential for this method to contribute to earlier and more accurate detection of brain tumors, ultimately aiding in reducing the high mortality rate associated with this disease.

articleTitle: Enhanced Interpupillary Distance Identification for Children Using YOLOv5 and YOLOX Object Detection Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Interpupillary distance (IPD), which is the distance between the centers of the pupils of the eyes, is a key measurement in many applications, including optics, virtual reality, and medicine. Measuring IPD in adults is generally easier than measuring it in children due to adults' more stable eye positions and greater cooperation during the measurement process. Additionally, adults have a longer attention span, which aids in maintaining focus. Historically, technological options for accurately measuring IPD in children have been limited compared to those available for adults.In this work, we present a novel approach to accurately measure the IPD of children aged 5 to 15 years using an object detection model. Data were personally collected from students in this age group and subsequently pre-processed and annotated using labelImg software. The YoloV5 and YoloX models were employed for object detection, with YoloV5 demonstrating superior performance on the dataset. This model was utilized to locate the centers of the pupils and calculate the IPD using the Euclidean distance method between the centers of the bounding boxes for the detected pupils. The model accurately detected IPD while accounting for even the slightest variations in different eye movements and gazes, providing precise results. Additionally, a chin rest and a brief flash were incorporated as a gaze correction methodology to further enhance measurement accuracy. The precise measurement of IPD enables the customization of spectacles for children, ensuring better fit and comfort.

articleTitle: Crop Recommendation and Yield Prediction using Machine learning and Deep learning models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Agriculture remains the predominant livelihood provider in India contributing to India's Gross Domestic Product (GDP). Recent advancements in technology like precision agriculture and agri-tech solutions, have improved efficiency. However, the domain faces challenges due to climate change, water scarcity, and land degradation. This research focuses on leveraging machine learning (ML) and deep learning (DL) models to address these challenges through crop recommendation and yield prediction. In this paper a combined system for crop recommendation and yield prediction is done using a comprehensive dataset that has factors like pH, rainfall, state name, crop type, crop name, N, P, K, humidity, area in hectares, production, temperature, and yield in tons per hectare. Preprocessing techniques were applied to improve data quality and model accuracy. The dataset is trained using machine learning models (K-Nearest Neighbors, Random Forest and Decision Tree) and deep learning models (Artificial Neural Network-ANN, Long Short-Term Memory-LSTM, Deep Neural Network-DNN). The findings indicate that K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) and Random Forest among the other ML models provide superior accuracy. Random Forest (RF) achieved the best accuracy in crop recommendation (99.3%) and KNN performed well in yield prediction (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> score: 0.985). Among DL models, LSTM has higher efficiency both in terms of crop recommendation (97%) and yield prediction (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> score: 0.930). Integration of these models will help farmers to make decisions related to crop selection and the yield which will eventually result in increased productivity and sustainability. The insights from this paper highlights the advantages of data driven approaches in handling difficulties encountered by farmers, thus paving way for a sustainable and food secure future.

articleTitle: EfficientNet-B4 Based Deep Learning for Automated Paddy Leaf Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Paddy leaf diseases can have a major impact on the yield and quality of paddy crops, which emphasizes the need of early and precise disease detection for efficient disease management. In this paper, we present an EfficientNet architecture-based deep learning method for paddy leaf disease classification. Compound scaling of EfficientNet makes it possible to preserve computational economy while achieving better performance. We assess our methods using a dataset that includes four illness classifications: Brown Spot, Hispa, Leaf Blast, and Healthy. Our suggested approach outperforms both previous deep learning models and orthodox machine learning techniques, with an accuracy of 85.7%. EfficientNet performs better than other CNN models in terms of accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, according to comparative research. Because of its remarkable accuracy, efficiency, and resilience, EfficientNet performs better than other solutions, making it a viable option for automatic paddy leaf disease classification in real-world agricultural situations.

articleTitle: Scrapetalk: Chatbot Conversation with Web Scraped Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: ScrapeTalk represents a paradigm shift in the realm of conversational AI, offering users an innovative platform for accessing information with unprecedented efficiency and accuracy. This paper explores the development and implementation of ScrapeTalk, an AI-powered chatbot that integrates web-scraped insights to revolutionize conversational experiences. Leveraging advanced technologies including LangChain, OpenAI, Streamlit UI, BeautifulSoup4, WebBaseLoader, and ChromaDB, ScrapeTalk delivers unparalleled convenience in information retrieval across a vast spectrum of topics. By employing sophisticated web scraping techniques, ScrapeTalk enables users to save up to 50% of their time compared to traditional manual web searches, accessing data from over 1 billion websites. The integration of the RAG Model Methodology and LangChain ensures seamless natural language processing, facilitating coherent and contextually relevant interactions. Additionally, the incorporation of the OpenAI API enhances ScrapeTalk’s ability to generate intelligent responses based on retrieved insights. ChromaDB efficiently handles data transformation and storage, optimizing resource management for swift access to information. Through continuous evolution and integration of new advancements, ScrapeTalk exemplifies the potential of conversational AI to simplify information access and enhance user experiences in the digital age

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Human Resources Management Using Deep Belief Learning Approach For Talent Acquisition And Retention In The Digital Era
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Background: In the modern digital age, Human Resources (HR) is faced with unique challenges in attracting and retaining skilled individuals. Traditional HR methods may struggle to keep up with the evolving needs of today's workforce. Methods: This study aims to address these challenges by proposing a new approach - integrating Deep Belief Learning (DBL) into HR management. The main issue is the limitations of traditional techniques in predicting and meeting the diverse needs of employees in the digital era, leading to a loss of talented individuals. Our research fills this gap by using DBL, an advanced machine learning method, to analyze large datasets and uncover important patterns in employee behavior. To ensure comprehensive results, we combine quantitative analysis of past HR data with qualitative insights from employee surveys and interviews. Results: The DBL model is specifically designed to identify complex patterns, allowing for accurate predictions of employee preferences and potential turnover risks. The results of this study show a significant improvement in talent acquisition and retention rates, highlighting the potential of DBL in HR management.

articleTitle: Forecasting AI Evolution: A Data-Driven Trend Analysis until 2030
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) plays a significant role in transforming various sectors across the world. Beyond technological advancement, AI also promotes socio-economic growth. Hence, forecasting AI trends holds immense significance in anticipating technological evolutions and their impact on diverse sectors. In the proposed study, data analytics is used to predict the trend of AI until 2030. Data analytics is revolutionizing the way we perceive and harness data-driven insights. This field encloses a wide range of methods, including data mining, predictive modeling, and machine learning. In the study, datasets containing the trends of AI across various sectors globally from the year 2017 to 2021 were pre-processed. Then, Excel’s linear forecast function is used to forecast the trend of AI and is validated using Python’s linear regression. Since the advancement of AI has positioned it as an integral part of the future, these tools will help explore historical data to uncover trends and potential future developments in AI. The outcomes of the study were then analyzed manually. The study concludes that AI plays a significant role in the global economy which may be influenced by various factors.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Asthma Control Using Random Forest Machine Learning Enhancement Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Breathlessness, wheezing, and frequently fatal bouts are hallmarks of asthma, an inflammatory and airway-induced lung disease. Asthma sufferers must be able to anticipate major exacerbations brought on by uncontrolled asthma. Thus, a framework is required that can most accurately forecast a patient's chance of developing asthma. In this work, the Random Forest algorithm has been employed to mine the data including patients' past health records in order to provide an efficient mechanism for asthma disease prediction. In machine learning, it is a strong ensemble learning technique extensively applied to classification and regression problems. Its resilience, scalability, and high dimensionality handling of complicated datasets are well known. Being a member of the tree-based method family, Random Forest gets its power from combining the predictions of several decision trees. We have forecasted with 75% accuracy after applying the random forest class. After it was demonstrated that the Random Forest can be used to create an asthma disease prediction model. The model looks for those who are at risk of getting asthma or having flare-ups by examining a number of patient-related variables, including demographics, medical history, environmental exposures, and genetic predispositions.

articleTitle: MotionGuard: ESP32 CAM-Powered Smart Flooring System for Enhanced Security
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Traditional home security systems often face limitations in effectively addressing evolving security threats, such as theft and intrusion. These systems typically rely on conventional sensors and surveillance techniques, which may overlook crucial aspects of security, such as real-time monitoring and comprehensive threat detection. For instance, some systems may have limited coverage of entry points or may rely solely on single-factor authentication methods, rendering them vulnerable to sophisticated intrusions. In response to these shortcomings, our proposed solution introduces a novel anti-theft security system leveraging modern IoT (Internet of Things) technologies. One key feature of our system is the integration of ESP32 CAM, a versatile microcontroller for real-time monitoring of the premises. This allows homeowners to monitor their property remotely and receive instant alerts in case of any suspicious activity. Additionally, we incorporate a Telegram bot interface, enabling seamless communication between the system and the homeowner for immediate response to security threats. By addressing the limitations of previous systems, our proposed solution aims to enhance home security by providing multi-modal threat detection and proactive surveillance capabilities. Through a systematic approach to security system design and implementation, we seek to establish a robust and adaptable framework capable of safeguarding residential premises against unauthorized access and intrusion.

articleTitle: Review of AR and VR Technology in Civil Engineering
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Augmented reality (AR) is that converts and provides enhancement in the real-life world into computer information and virtual reality (VR) is that converts computer generated information and models to occupy the real world which actually looks like the factual. The aim of this research paper is to understand the technologies of AR and VR. in the Civil engineering field. The technology is widely being used in construction field because of the many benefits it provides both qualitatively and quantitatively. In present-time most of the social media, Journal articles, Conferences, Conference proceedings, books are insisting on AR and VR technology but the exact knowledge about this have not reached many researchers. This paper tries to provide a sound knowledge about the AR and VR to the civil engineering researchers those who are willing to upgrade themselves in the research field with the present and blooming technologies. In the civil engineering field AR and VR were used for variety of purposes such as visualizing plans, providing an amazing user experience, interactive design development, walk through design, reducing error and shortening the design time in architecture, while in construction, these technologies were used for efficient translation of architectural drawings, creating superior design and development, reducing error during construction, better marketing of the construction projects, saving valuable man-hours, easy review of project designs, and overall cost reduction.

articleTitle: Recommending Favorable Locations for Electric Vehicle Charging Station Placement
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: This paper seeks to establish how the positioning of charging stations affects economic growth and towards the conclusive determination of areas that would be most strategic to position the charging stations to boost economic returns. As such, this research categorizes the existing electrical automotive charging solutions and demographic, financial, and infrastructural indicators to give policymakers and investors interested in revitalizing local economies valuable information. The conclusions and recommendations of this investigation will form a new addition to the knowledge of sustainable transport and its effects on the growth of the economy.

articleTitle: Optical, Mechanical and Dielectric Behavior of Urea and Thiourea Doped Lithium Sulphate Monohydrate Single Crystals
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: The slow evaporation method was employed to obtain single crystals of urea and thiourea-doped lithium sulphate monohydrate (LSM). The modified lattice properties of the doped LSM crystals were examined by single crystal X-ray diffraction analysis. The doped crystals showed very minimal absorption between 200 and 1200 nm in wavelength, according to studies on optical absorption. FTIR analysis was utilized to detect the existence of functional groups inside the crystal. To verify that dopants were present, EDAX analysis was performed. For doped crystals, microhardness tests were performed, and numerous types of parameters were found, including fracture toughness, brittle index, yield strength and elastic stiffness coefficient. For the doped crystals, measurements of the dielectric constant and dielectric loss were made at various temperatures and frequencies. The enhanced NLO activity of the doped crystals was verified by Kurtz and Perry’s powder method.

articleTitle: Maximizing Efficiency in Smart Contract Execution Costs Techniques for Cost Optimization on Blockchain Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Blockchain is a digital ledger distributed across numerous computers globally, eliminating the need for intermediaries. Platforms such as Ethereum leverage blockchain technology to facilitate not only financial transactions but also Smart Contracts. Running these Smart Contracts incurs gas fees, which are influenced by the complexity of the operations. This research explores various methods to design and organize Smart Contracts to reduce gas usage on the Ethereum network. The study identifies key strategies for optimizing Smart Contract design, resulting in significant reductions in gas costs. These strategies include optimizing data structures, minimizing storage operations, and efficient coding practices. By implementing the proposed methods, developers can create more cost-effective and efficient Smart Contracts, ultimately enhancing the overall usability and sustainability of the Ethereum network.

articleTitle: An AI-Powered Multi-Functional Text-Based Assistive System for People with Disabilities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: The research proposes an expanded definition and a novel tactic for increasing accessibility through the invention of an eye-controlled software application. Unlike typical approaches that need peripheral devices which are often bulky and cumbersome this system uses Pyautogui for cursor movement based on eye detection by Computer Vision therefore it is natural and easy. Incorporation of sound feedback using JavaScript as a part of touch free method improves key recognition. There are features such as text creation with the option to download, increasing flexibility when working with different files. Furthermore, using speech identification technology required for the controlling, as well as the navigation through the voice commands, software management independence is encouraged. The solution is integrated with the newest technologies that allow making resources as accessible for any learners with disabilities to minimize isolation in the digital world. Research insights show that the desired objectives of this system also help with employability and improve interaction and inclusivity. The idea of the eye-controlled software is to make assistive technologies enhance the quality of life for disabled people, as they no longer have to rely on others to operate technology.

articleTitle: Effective Manner of Healthcare Management System for Hepatitis virus using PCA-BFF Optimization Algorithm with Clinical Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Hepatitis, originating from a viral bacterium, adversely affects the liver. Due to limited precautionary knowledge, the death rate is increasing. Early-stage intervention is vital for improved living standards. Machine Learning (ML) methods effectively predict diseases early, reducing human mortality. The proposed method unfolds in two phases, In the first phase, the feature detection technique employs a Principal Component Analysis (PCA) with a Hybrid Bat and FireFly Optimization Algorithm (HBFFOA) to enhance performance. In the second phase, to decrease misclassification errors and increase accuracy, the Iterative Dichotomiser with Decision Tree (ID3-DT) method is adopted. According to the experimental results, the PCA-HBFFOA technique consistently outperforms an accuracy rate of 97.1%. Evaluation metrics encompass accuracy, precision, recall, f-measure, and processing time. Additionally, the proposed method exhibits shorter execution times of 3.5 seconds for the hepatitis dataset. Looking ahead, future work will explore an ensemble classification method tailored to diverse hepatitis datasets, aiming to further optimize the overall solution.

articleTitle: Detecting IoT Network Breach Using the Random Forest Classifier
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Intrusion detection faces particular issues due to the interconnection and resource constraints of Internet of Things (IoT) devices. A complete collection of network traffic statistics pertaining to IoT security situations may be found in the CIC-IDS 2018 dataset. In this work, the Random Forest classifier, a flexible machine learning technique renowned for its high accuracy in handling heterogeneous data is used to address the critical problem of IoT network security. The intrusion detection system is developed using features taken from the CIC-IDS 2018 dataset, and it achieves an astounding accuracy rate of 99.96%.This remarkable outcome shows how well the Random Forest classifier works to identify and classify different types of network intrusions, including those that affect Internet of Things devices. The study enhances the security stance of Internet of Things networks by offering valuable perspectives on the application of machine learning methods for dependable intrusion detection in IoT environments.

articleTitle: Prediction Of Chronic Kidney Disease On Ct Images Using Deep Learning: Resnet-34 And Vggnet-16
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Kidney is considered as the most essential and important organ of our human body. Many factors such as diabetes, high blood pressure, inherited kidney disease, abnormal structure of kidney etc., affects the filtration rate of the kidney and in turn leads to chronic kidney disease. İf disease is identified and properly treated at early stages, human life can be saved. But in most cases, it cannot be done since there is no proper symptoms in the early stages. Huge of data is produced in the medical industry daily and it is left unattended. If this data is utilized properly, many useful information can be found. The use of Artificial Intelligence to assist medical professionals is increasing day by day. In this research work, we have used two famous deep learning architectures: RESNET and VGGNET to predict the existence of Chronic Kidney Disease. To improve the prediction accuracy, Artificial Bee Colony algorithm is used for segmentation. Instead of giving the original image as input, segmented image is given. The experiments shows that the VGGNET architecture produces higher accuracy of 98% than the RESNET architecture which gives an accuracy of 96%.

articleTitle: Techno-Economic Study of Grid-Integrated Solar Residential Energy Management (REM) System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Background- Solar energy is an increasingly popular renewable energy source, thanks to the decreasing cost of solar panels, especially photovoltaic (PV) panels. Numerous nations offer financial incentives to promote the adoption of solar energy, including tax credits and fabrication incentives. Solar photovoltaic (PV) systems can operate independently or in conjunction with the electrical grid. Methods- Analysis is then performed to test the effectiveness of the projected REM procedure in minimizing maximum requirement while maintaining customer comfort. The objective of the REM algorithm is to reduce the number of appliances that are turned off in order to minimize demand. Results- The survey outcomes are crucial for generating load profiles for an entire year. Concluding Remarks-This research provides information on smart homes' components required for solar PV systems. It also conducts a cost analysis of installation, maintenance, and operational costs to evaluate the proposed configuration. The results validate the efficacy of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Enhancing Parkinson’s Disease Diagnosis Using Logistic Regression and KNN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Parkinson’s disease is a neurogenerative condition that affects motor control. The condition appears when dopamine-producing brain neurons, which are essential for controlling smooth muscle, begin to fail. Early diagnosis of Parkinson’s disease motor symptoms allows a patient to receive appropriate care at the appropriate moment. The most suitable machine learning method for Parkinson disease diagnosis is compared in this work between logistic regression and k-nearest neighbor (KNN). Voice measures are among the plethora of clinical and demographic data on the participants in the research dataset. Which composes of 31 people, 23 with Parkinson’s disease. Furthermore, voice attribute information used to detect the disease includes MDVP: Fo (Hz), MDVP: Fhi (Hz), himmer: DDA, and many more. Preliminary results show that both Logistic Regression and K-Nearest Neighbor can distinguish between people with Parkinson disease and healthy individuals, but K-Nearest neighbor algorithm outperformed Logistic Regression by achieving 86% accuracy, compared to the 85% accuracy attained by Logistic Regression. The findings suggest that Logistic Regression and KNN are viable tools for Parkinson disease prediction. The study shows that machine learning methods can be very useful for the early diagnosis of Parkinson disease.

articleTitle: Prediction of Coronary Artery Calcium with CT-Images using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: The coronary-artery-calcium(CAC)-score of CT is a popular tool for recognition of coronary-artery disease. Nevertheless, the present diagnostic approach utilizing CAC-score CT is laborious, since the radiologist needs to meticulously examine each CT image individually and verify the precise range. This research applies three convolutional neural network (CNN) models to 1200 CT scans of the cardiovascular system, including both normal and calcium-containing scans. As part of our experimental test, we categorize the CT-image data into three different sets: original CAC-score CT, cardiac-segmented, and cardiac-cropped images. The former set includes the entire rib cage, while the latter two sets exclude all but the heart region. The investigational test for determining the incidence of calcium in a CT-picture utilizing the Inception ResnetV2, VGG, and Resnet50 are yielded the best results with a 98.52% accuracy rate when the Resnet 50 model was applied to cardiac cropped image data. As a result, the authors of this work hope that future studies will pave the way for automated calcium study scores for each CAC-score CT as well as for the detection of calcium alone.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Characteristics of Underwater Wireless Optical Channel based on Turbulence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Underwater Wireless Optical Communication (UWOC) is a transformative technology that leverages the propagation of light through water to enable high-speed data transmission in submerged environments. Turbulence, caused by factors such as water currents, temperature gradients, and other hydrodynamic phenomena, poses significant challenges to optical signal propagation. This work examines an UWOC channel model, taking into account the effects of various water mediums, absorption, scattering, and refractive index. First, the impact of air bubbles and the refractive index (air and water medium) on received power levels in relation to connection length has been examined. A noticeable decrease (66%) in received optical power has been observed (at d=50 meters) upon switching from air to water as the transmission medium. Similarly, even taking into account the impact of air bubbles in the aqueous medium, no discernible difference in received power was seen. On the other hand, when there were no air bubbles, the received power was significantly lower. When the transmitted power was decreased by 66%, a 71.42% reduction in optical power has been observed (at λ=460). The impacts of salinity, turbidity, temperature change, and air bubbles caused the received power levels to reach zero at λ=530 nm. The received power level decreased by 60.74% at a distance of 10 meters when the water medium changed from pure sea to clear ocean, and by 91.07% when the water medium moved from pure sea to coastal ocean. The transition from clear sea to turbid harbor in the water medium did not result in any substantial received power. This is because turbid harbor water has higher attenuation values than clean seawater.

articleTitle: Echo Insights: YouTube Sentiment Analysis App
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: In an era where social media is getting a wider attraction seeing an improvement in content creators than consumers, ECHO INSIGHTS is a tool for analyzing YouTube video sentiments. This mainly focusses on creating an analytical tool that inputs a YouTube video link from user and uses YouTube API V3 to fetch comments from the video and organize them into a dataframe using pandas. For global audacity, these extracted comments are translated into English using Google trans library in Python. Subsequently, each of the fetched results are assigned with sentiments using Vader, a pre trained sentiment analysis model with a better accuracy of 96%. Then the analyzed results are displayed in a intuitive dashboard designed using streamlit enabling users to interpret sentiment patterns in the content. The dashboard offers various visualization contents like, good and bad comments based on Vader sentiment providing a clear view on sentiments of comments. Additionally, a summarized sentiment score is also displayed, providing general tone of the video. One of the additional features of out webapp is Wordcloud, a python library that plots most comments used or relevant words in the fetched comments representing a quicker glance in video engagement and users’ opinions on video. ECHO INSIGHTS aims to empower content creators with better analysis and a healthier component and understanding of audience feedback and engagement with videos. Overall enabling users and creators with continuous improvement and optimization of their content, thus acting as a goof asset by translating raw comments till overall sentiment facilitating deeper connection with audience and crafting contents more efficiently.

articleTitle: A Robust Detection and Classification of Epileptic Seizures using Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: The brain, one of the most vital organs in the human body, is responsible for the functions of the entire nervous system. Conditions affecting the brain pose significant risks to overall health. Epilepsy, along with other neurological conditions such as Parkinson’s disease (PD) and Alzheimer’s disease (AD), is characterised by uncontrollable surges of neurochemical activity in the brain, which ultimately result in seizures. Identifying these seizures is crucial for successful research and treatment. Electroencephalography (EEG) is a technique commonly used to analyze brain activity and diagnose neurological disorders like epilepsy. Historically, neurologists have dedicated considerable time to visually inspecting EEG data to identify anomalies associated with epilepsy. This work introduces a deep learning (DL) strategy for categorizing epileptic episodes based on its findings. To implement DLtechniques like Convolutional Neural Networks (ConvNet), we utilized a dataset from Bonn University. This dataset contains spectral data from 128 channels. Seizure classification was specifically done using the VGG19 DL method. The ConvNet model achieves an outstanding level of accurate categorization with a testing classification accuracy range of 97.82% to 99.57%.

articleTitle: Diabetic Retinopathy Identification From Retinal Images With The Use Of A Deep Learning-Based Transfer Training Framework
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Diabetic retinopathy (DR) is a major contributor to vision loss worldwide, highlighting the urgent need for early identification and prompt care to prevent further deterioration of vision. Diagnosing DR is intrinsically difficult, since it requires the thorough evaluation of complex retinal images by skilled professionals. DR, a consequence of diabetes, has the potential to cause vision loss if not identified in its early stages. research presents a novel model that utilizes transfer learning to detect diabetic retinopathy. The first trials yielded poor accuracies for both training and validation. The categorization of class-4, especially those depicting severe instances, yielded unexpected outcomes, since several images were categorized as moderate. Consequently, more investigation is required to ascertain the accuracy of these classifications. Therefore, our suggested approach allows for easy classification of the retina pictures of both Diabetic and Healthy individuals, resulting in a decrease in the number of evaluations required by medical specialists.

articleTitle: Forecasting Future Electricity Consumption in IoT-Linked Meters Using Machine Learning: The Power Prophecy Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: The conventional method of manually reading energy meters have been associated with inefficiencies and error-prone processes. To address these challenges, there’s been a growing interest in leveraging advanced technologies to revolutionize metering systems. One such innovation involves the integration of Machine Learning models with existing energy meters to create smart meters capable of predictive analysis. In this envisioned model, Machine Learning algorithms are utilized to predict electricity usage for the forthcoming month based on historical data collected from the smart electric meter. By analyzing patterns and trends in the preceding month’s readings, the model can generate accurate forecasts, empowering users with insights into their future electricity consumption. These predictions are then displayed through a user-friendly interface, providing real-time access to usage data and projected costs. Moreover, the execution of automatic meter activation and deactivation, alongside customizable threshold settings for alerts, add a layer of efficiency and convenience. By proactively notifying users of potential excessive power consumption, individuals are empowered to actively monitor and manage their electricity usage, ultimately leading to savings in both energy expenditure and expenses. This project not only augments the accuracy and efficiency of metering processes but also contributes to broader sustainability efforts by encouraging environmentally conscious practices. Equipping consumers with the tools and insights needed To make enlightened choices regarding their energy usage, the integration of machine learning into smart metering systems represent a significant step towards creating a more sustainable future

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review on the Prediction of Video Frame and Motion Contents
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: The capability of predicting, or analyzing the future outcomes of motion pictures using intelligent systems is the video frame prediction process. Video frame prediction is a significant and challenging aspect of Computer Vision (CV) applications. Video prediction plays a vital role in terms of robotics and Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications in detecting the future frames of a video, depending on which, the decision-making process can be carried out. The existing video frame prediction processes include pixel law based and motion-based predictions, which have been proven to be ambiguous. This leads to inaccurate predictions and indirectly deteriorates the performance of the real time applications. This paper performs a detailed review of the existing methodologies, their merits, pitfalls and challenges that create havoc in the video frame prediction process. In addition, this paper performs a detailed analysis on the existing datasets that assist in the video prediction process. This review summarizes various methodologies and datasets along with their performance analysis, which will open research possibilities in the field of video frame prediction.

articleTitle: Study on the Design of a Industrial Peb Building
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: The project is focused on comparison of cost estimates of industrial buildings based on conventional and pre-engineered steel design using Indian code. Many parameters such as building sizes, environmental loads and yield stress values, deflection limit and design codes affect the design of steel members. Industrial gable building is taken for the project work based on location at Puducherry. The analysis of the structure was done using STAAD-PRO software and manual design of the members was carried out as per Indian standards. Portal frame, brace, roof purlins & wall girts analyzed and designed as per Conventional and Pre-Engineered Building concepts. Loads are calculated in accordance with Indian codes. For pre-engineered buildings, cold formed sections are used. Bill of materials is calculated and cost estimates are taken for comparative study. The analytical study revealed the better performance of Pre-Engineered Building than the Conventional Steel Building (CSB) both in design and cost. In PEB, due to the reduction in steel, the dead load is reduced. In PEB the dead load is small which will eventually reduce the foundation size and hence the cost of foundation is reduced. The diagonal bracing for the PEB design offers more feasibility and structural safety as it resists the horizontal forces, which causes sway and deformation in the structure. Therefore, PEB is more advantageous than CSB and can be used for greater spans.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Solid Waste Classification and Monitoring Alert System using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Efficient waste control is critical for India's smart cities. This study uses Convolutional Neural network (CNN) technology to classify and reveal waste, integrating sensors, Internet of Things (IoT) gadgets, and system studying to promote sustainability. Also targets to deal with inefficient waste management by using CNN technology for effective garbage classification and tracking. The device integrates sensors, IoT devices, and machine learning algorithms to sort and track waste, promoting sustainable practices and environmental conservation. The proposed system uses an ArduinoMKR1000 microcontroller, ultrasonic sensors, and jumper wires to monitor garbage bin levels and classify waste into biodegradable and non-biodegradable classes the usage of CNN algorithms. The system employs the DenseNet121 model for image type and makes use of ThingSpeak for real-time tracking and notifications. The experimental consequences display an accuracy of 95% for the DenseNet121 version, outperforming traditional CNN and ResNet-50 architectures. The proposed device's overall performance surpasses that of different models because of its dense connectivity and efficient feature map creation. Real-time monitoring and data analytics provide precious insights for waste reduction and sustainability tasks, contributing to cleaner, greener, and more sustainable environments for future generations.

articleTitle: Automated Waiter Robot Using Smart Menu And Obstacle Avoidance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: The growing utilization of robots is revolutionizing our daily lives, making tasks more efficient and convenient. However, challenges persist in restaurants and hotels, including overcrowding, limited waiter availability, and manual order processing. To address these issues, our project focuses on designing and constructing a waiter robot to assist restaurants. This robot will streamline restaurant operations by taking customer orders and serving tables, resulting in smoother service and quicker food delivery. Equipped with special sensors, it will identify tables requiring assistance and feature a smart menu system for seamless ordering, minimizing order errors and expediting the process. Additionally, obstacle avoidance sensors will ensure the robot navigates the restaurant environment effortlessly. Ultimately, our project aims to enhance the dining experience for all, making dining out a more enjoyable and efficient endeavor.

articleTitle: PID Controller Optimization for a Three-Link Robot Manipulator Using RGA
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach for optimizing Proportional-Integral-Derivative (PID) controllers applied to three-link robot manipulators (RM) using a Real-coded Genetic Algorithm (RGA). The complexity of controlling multilink robotic systems requires advanced optimization techniques to achieve precise and stable performance. Traditional methods of tuning PID controllers often fall short due to the exceedingly nonlinear and correlated dynamics of robotic manipulators. In this study, a Real-coded Genetic Algorithm is utilized to determine the optimal PID controller parameters, enhancing the system's response time, stability, and overall performance. Simulations are conducted to confirm the effectiveness of the proposed optimization method. The results demonstrate substantial enhancements in the manipulators' trajectory tracking and disturbance refutation abilities contrasted to conventional PID tuning methods. This research highlights the potential of genetic algorithms in advancing control strategies for complex robotic systems, offering valuable insights for future developments in robotic control applications.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Tapioca Harvesting Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Traditionally, tapioca harvesting has been manual, requiring 22-40 man-days per hectare and costing ₹10,000-₹15,000 per day. This labor-intensive process burdens farmers, who often receive poor returns from industries like sago manufacturers. An automated harvester machine is proposed to streamline harvesting, featuring a 1200 rpm roller chain saw, plow shovel, conveyor system, and 12V battery. This machine will reduce labor costs and time, offering both rental and purchase options. Low-income farmers can rent the machine, while industries can buy it. This innovation aims to reduce labor dependency, lower costs, and increase efficiency in cassava farming. By mechanizing the harvesting process, farmers can significantly reduce labor costs and the overall investment in harvesting. The machine can perform the task faster than manual labor, reducing the time required for harvesting. The machine will be available for both one-time purchase and rental, catering to different needs. A rental basis is ideal for low-income farmers who harvest every 6-7 months, making the machine accessible without a significant upfront cost.

articleTitle: An Adapative Machine Learning Approach For Autonomous Detection and Classification of Marine Life in Underwater Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Deep Learning technology, particularly in aquatic ecology, is crucial for recognizing marine organisms amidst the complexities of underwater environments. This study introduces a computer vision system using the 'Super Gradients' pre-trained model, a PyTorch-Based training library, for detecting and classifying marine species. Employing a newly developed Sea Animals Image Dataset with annotated images of fish, crabs, and starfish in brackish water with varying visibility, the 'Super Gradients' model demonstrated high accuracy in species classification. The annotated dataset enhances research by providing diverse training data. Key findings reveal the model's significant impact on detection and classification accuracy, the dataset's robustness, and the model's effectiveness in feature extraction. The integration of advanced deep learning and comprehensive datasets improves marine monitoring efficiency and reliability, addressing underwater environment challenges and offering future research insights. This study underscores the importance of automated systems in aquatic ecology, highlighting technological advancements and key concerns in the field.

articleTitle: Virtual Flow Meter Design Combining Pressure Sensing and Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Over the past few years, many oil companies have invested in the research of making autonomous and digital models. This research can help in the development of society and improvement of accuracy and production. As the world is in need of petrol and its subordinates, the industry and the education sector are deployed in finding the digital smart solutions. A virtual flow meter (VFM) is one such solution, providing an affordable way to continuously predict flow rates in petroleum production systems. Traditional hardware metering devices, which can be prohibitively expensive, are replaced by data-driven models that utilize readily available field measurement data, such as pressure readings. These properties serve as the training data for the model. Based on the pressure sensor readings, the developed model can accurately compute the flow rates. In this approach, the model integrates both first principles and data-driven methodologies to precisely estimate water flow rates.

articleTitle: HMDDD: Hybrid Model for Distracted Driver Detection through Fusion of CNN and VGG-16
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: There has been an increase in the total number of road accidents leading to fatal injuries and deaths in recent years. A major reason behind these staggering figures are distracted drivers. The research aims to develop a model which will identify whether a driver is distracted or not. This study uses Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to classify and detect driver distractions. Utilizing a dataset from the 2016 State Farm Challenge on Kaggle, CNN architectures were refined, including standard and modified VGG-16 models. Initial results with a simple CNN yielded a log loss of 2.67118 and an accuracy of 0.994872. Transfer learning with VGG-16 architectures improved performance, with Model Architecture-1 achieving a log loss of 1.93189. Further enhancement techniques, such as dropout, Xavier initialization, and fine-tuning, resulted in an optimized VGG-16 model with a final log loss of 1.26397, demonstrating superior accuracy.

articleTitle: Shopkeeper’s Help - Advanced Inventory Management and Predictive Sales System in Retail Operations
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Inventory Management Systems (IMS) play a vital role in harmonizing supply and demand dynamics within businesses, ensuring optimal product availability at the right time and place. This analysis explores their fundamental functionalities, goals, and advantages. IMS diligently monitor inventory levels, predict demand, and optimize replenishment processes to achieve equilibrium between excess stock and shortages. IMS aim to reduce expenses by minimizing waste and theft while leveraging data analytics to uncover trends that inform pricing and marketing strategies. Industries spanning retail, manufacturing, and healthcare rely on IMS to navigate inventory complexities, driving cost efficiencies and customer satisfaction through informed decision-making. They automate routine tasks, streamline operations, and offer valuable insights for strategic planning. Key objectives include maintaining optimal stock levels to balance costs and customer satisfaction, enhancing operational efficiency through automation, and improving customer service by ensuring timely product availability.

articleTitle: Analysis the Future of Artificial Intelligence in Green Human Resource Management and its Talent Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: The goal of the current study is to determine how artificial intelligence (AI) technologies are influencing HRM practices, namely in the areas of recruitment, employee experience, data-driven decision-making, and learning and development. With the main objective of understanding how AI is changing traditional HR responsibilities, it examines the potential advantages, difficulties, and repercussions of incorporating AI into HR practices. A thorough analysis of the body of literature on artificial intelligence in the HR domain comprised the first section of the research study. Examining pertinent academic journals, industry reports, and other sources was necessary to create a strong knowledge base and pinpoint research gaps. The study is qualitative as well as descriptive. The study's findings led to the following conclusion: AI gives recruiters a helpful tool for optimizing talent; clever AI technology will progressively replace repetitive administrative tasks, allowing HR executives and recruiters to concentrate more on tactical duties; and AI solutions will facilitate job searches for individuals. AI will revolutionize hiring, increase learning and development programs, boost employee happiness, and enable data-driven decision-making. Despite the difficulties, overcoming them will enable companies to fully incorporate AI into HR, increasing productivity, efficacy, and employee satisfaction. This paper advances the subject by thoroughly analyzing the ways in which AI has transformed HR procedures. Its practical insights, problem identification, implications for organizational performance, and identification of potential research subjects are beneficial to HR practitioners.

articleTitle: Optimizing Menstruation Symptom Management: A Machine Learning Approach to Personalized Nutrition Recommendations
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: This research provides through method for building a recommendation system for health concerns for women the significant number of individuals’ day-to-day activities are affected by menstruation symptoms including pains, mood swings and fatigue. Be it making an individual food prescription or eradicating these symptoms, nutrition is an absolute factor. Thus, according to this work, there is a concept of a method that based on machine learning will help predict menstrual symptoms and provide tailored nutrition recommendations. The analysis of the respondents scores for six menstrual cycles revealed that magnesium, omega-3 fatty acids, vitamin D, and calcium are significant nutrients affecting the symptom severity level. Various Machine Learning models to compared include the Neural Networks, Support Vector Machines and Random Forests. Out of all the models the highest was achieved by the Random Forest model for the targeted recommendations of the proper nutrition adjusted to the person, where the prediction accuracy was 98%. The findings of the provided results support the view that is hope and the intensity of menstruation symptoms reduced significantly.

articleTitle: Efficient Weather Detection Using Lightweight Convolutional Neural Networks suitable for Implementing and Deploying on Edge Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Weather detection is vital in many fields, including disaster recovery, farming, transportation, and climate studies. Making educated decisions and reducing potential dangers requires the quick and precise observation of weather patterns. As CNN-based deep learning models automatically train and extract significant features from raw image data, they often achieve higher accuracy in a variety of image classification tasks and exhibit good data generalization. In addition to the accurate detection, it should be lightweight to deploy to edge locations. To address this, we have developed a Smart lightweight deep-learning model to detect the weather accurately and it can be conveniently deployable in resource-constrained devices. This study uses several deep lightweight learning models, including MobileNetV2, MobileNetV3_Small, and NasNetMobile, where MobileNetV3_Small is the most efficient regarding weather detection and computational complexity reduction. The proposed approach utilized a Multi-class Weather Dataset for Image Classification for building Smart lightweight deep-learning models. Besides the weather classification, the proposed approach also gives the confidence score for the predicted climate, which provides a numerical indicator to evaluate how likely the predicted climate is to occur.

articleTitle: Segmentation of Lung Images Using Hybridization of Fuzzy C Means and Morphological Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: One of the serious illnesses that could shorten a patient’s life is lung cancer. In addition, it is challenging to detect lung cancer early on and most cases are discovered after the disease has spread to other lung regions. The lung cancer tumoral tissue must be located by radiologist and other medical specialists. Consequently, the suggested work makes it easier to segment tumoral tissue from the CT lung image. Lung image segmentation is a crucial task in the field of medical image analysis because it allows lung abnormalities to be recognized and described. In order to achieve better performance hybrid strategies—which combine several approaches—have grown in popularity recently. Morphological operations are combined with fuzzy c-means clustering in this particular hybrid approach. In this work we provide a state-of-the-art overview of lung image segmentation using hybrid fuzzy c-means and morphological approaches. Hybrid techniques are an intriguing topic for additional research because it has been observed that their application can lead to increased resilience and accuracy when analyzing lung images.

articleTitle: Aquacleaner – An AI Enabled Robotic Trash Boat to Collect Floating Trash
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Effective trash management and environmental sustainability are crucial challenges that demand accurate classification of waste materials. Traditional sorting methods often fall short in achieving the precision necessary for optimizing recycling processes. This article presents an innovative approach utilizing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) to automatically classify waste materials, including plastics, paper, glass, organic debris, cardboard, and metals. CNNs are a great fit for this purpose because of their ability to extract complex patterns from input images and learn them. Using a number of experiments containing fine-tuning approaches and hyperparameter modifications, the proposed system is optimized after being trained on a broad dataset of trash images. This training process enhances the ability of the model to accurately differentiate between various waste types. When tested on a real-world garbage dataset, the CNN-based approach demonstrated superior classification accuracy and robustness, outperforming conventional machine learning techniques. The results highlight the potential of CNNs in improving waste sorting systems, leading to more efficient recycling processes. By accurately identifying and categorizing waste materials, this method supports environmental sustainability efforts by enhancing sorting and recycling efficiency. The proposed approach offers a scalable solution, making it a valuable tool for addressing waste management challenges and contributing to broader environmental sustainability goals.

articleTitle: Implementing the Predictive Model of Heuristic Algorithm-assisted Cascaded LSTM for Business Decision-making using Social Media Data
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: The evolution of social networks helps to rapidly spread information among people. From a wide range of unstructured data sources, business intelligence utilizes the information and transforms it into usable information to assist businesses in making effective decisions for increasing productivity and efficiency. The financial impact of the business on the company is analyzed by certain predictive systems. Predictive analytics boosts an organization’s competitiveness and determines the likelihood of a circumstance. The business organization faces issues related to business information and decision-making, such as inadequate planning, unavailability of resources, inability to identify risks and failure. To overcome such issues, a novel adaptive and automated model is proposed for decision-making in business. With the help of data from social media, a decision making process is implemented. For that purpose, the Adaptive Cascaded Long Short-Term Memory (ACasLSTM) is proposed for providing the decisive outcome. For further enhancement, the parameters of LSTM are optimally chosen by using the Squid Game Optimizer (SGO). Finally, results from the validation declare that it achieves a greater performance of making decisions effectively in the business world.

articleTitle: Improving Gain and Impedance Bandwidth of an E-Patch Microstrip Antenna operating at 6.6GHz
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: The first option for wireless communication systems is the Microstrip Patch Antenna (MPA), which has several advantages like being inexpensive, lightweight, and simple to configure. This paper discusses the construction of an optimized E-shaped patch antenna with ideal dimensions for wireless applications operating at 6.6 GHz to improve Gain and Bandwidth. This method is used to enhance gain and widen impedance bandwidth. This work contributes to reducing the difficulties that arise in the design and development of relatively small-sized microstrip patch antennas. This antenna’s primary uses are for Wi-Fi and WiMAX.
