The antenna’s performance is described by a number of parameters, including radiation pattern, band width, gain, and return loss. The MATLAB 2023 is the simulation software that was utilized to determine them.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Federated Learning Based on Malware Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: FL-LR, or Federated Learning Logistic Regression, enhances cybersecurity by using Federated Learning to detect malware in executable files. This approach allows decentralized devices to collaborate on training a Logistic Regression model without sharing raw data directly. Each device holds part of the malware dataset, ensuring data confidentiality. FL-LR's effectiveness is compared with Support Vector Machines and Random Forests using metrics like accuracy, precision, memory usage, F1-score, and AUROC. Results show FL-LR performs well while preserving data privacy. The study also examines FL-LR's scalability and convergence in federated settings, demonstrating its suitability for large-scale malware detection. Overall, FL-LR with Logistic Regression shows promise for enhancing cybersecurity through Federated Learning while protecting sensitive data.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approaches To Detect And Mitigate Cyberbullying In Online Communities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Cyberbullying is one of the new problems arising from the spread of social media throughout the past several years. The best way to ensure users' safety is to aggressively search for instances of cyberbullying and stop them right away. The basis of the present research is built from sophisticated language patterns used in cyberbullying, which beyond the reach of conventional machine learning methods. This paper proposes a fresh approach based on the properties of two recurrent neural networks to detect cyberbullying incidents. One of these networks feature extracting; the other has classification ability. This method is said to enable one to solve problems. This new approach efficiently extracts residual machine learning (RML) aspects using their features. Over numerous social media sites, the findings of an experimental investigation on the classification of cyberbullying writings reveal that the RML framework much surpassed its predecessors. The model performs better in memory, accuracy, and precision than more conventional methods about the challenging issue of cyberbullying.

articleTitle: Bandwidth Enhancement of Microstrip Filtenna using Defected Ground Structure (DGS) for IoT Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: A Defected Ground Structure (DGS) is employed to address the challenges of limited impedance bandwidth and increased subsystem complexity in IoT applications, which are common in traditional microstrip antennas. The proposed microstrip filtenna integrates a filter with a patch antenna using a 50 Ω quarter-wave microstrip line, built on an FR4 glass epoxy substrate. The design features a microstrip line feeding mechanism, a Stepped Impedance Resonator (SIR) filter, and a monopole radiating patch. Experimental results demonstrate significant bandwidth enhancement, with return losses of -22.0 dB at 5.5 GHz for the existing structure, and -13.58 dB at 6.5 GHz and -15.01 dB at 7.5 GHz for the proposed filtenna. The Voltage Standing Wave Ratio (VSWR) was also optimized to 1.15 at both 6.5 GHz and 7.5 GHz, indicating improved impedance matching. These advancements make the filtenna an ideal component for efficient and reliable IoT communication systems, enhancing its performance in high-frequency operations.

articleTitle: A Blockchain-based Secure Framework for Tender Allocation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: In the era of digital transformation, the expanding popularity of using information technology to transmit information, provide services, etc. One such area in which the public and commercial sectors collaborate is tendering. E-tendering is a procurement method that leverages digital technology and the internet to streamline and automate the entire tendering or bidding process. This facilitates the bidders to seamlessly go through all the available tenders in order to make contract with the tender. However, it often comes various problems/issues faced by both bidders and tenders. Due to its centralized framework, the system faces scaling and transparency issues, thus make the system inefficient. Also, for certain aspects, the system tends to share the tender information to other third-party organization that affects integrity and security of the tenders. To handle both the factors, a decentralized system is adopted for deploying the e-tendering system, Blockchain. This will make the procurement processes to embrace the power of blockchain technology for heightened security and transparency. This work aims to build a transparent, liquidate and secured e-tendering system that manages the tender allocation, with the help of smart contracts the automates the underlying processes by limiting the human involvement to minimal.

articleTitle: Hybrid photovoltaic thermal power cogeneration during different irradiances
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: The power demand is a predicament for the next generation due to the increasing number of consumer utilities and the development of most of the Electric Vehicle Charging Stations. Because of reduction of fossil fuels and environmental pollution, power generation by the use of natural resources should be considered. The co-generation of electrical power using a Photovoltaic Thermal Hybrid Solar Panel is useful for local power consumers like household home appliances. The photovoltaic (PV) cell is heated by the different modes of heating by natural sunlight and the corresponding variations of electrical power and thermal power are analyzed in this proposed research. The combined use of PV with thermal energy for heating the glasses of PV surfaces makes the system operate more efficiently and reliably to operate to get Maximum power from the cogeneration output. The proposed simulation includes the cogeneration of photovoltaic energy and thermal energy by the conversion process of converting the light energy into heat transfer by the Fresnel radiation method. Here the thermal energy transfer to the pumped water is simulated in different modes like radiation, convection, and conduction. In this analysis, the overall power generation by solar energy, the efficiency of generated electrical and thermal energy, and overall power generation are calculated.

articleTitle: Advancing Liver Cancer Diagnosis: Innovative Deep Learning Algorithms for Segmentation and Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Liver cancer is a significant worldwide health issue that requires precise diagnosis techniques and efficient treatment options. This paper presents sophisticated deep learning (DL) algorithms for the segmentation and classification of liver cancers, providing a thorough comparative comparison. The advancements in DL have led to significant progress in other domains. As a result, there is a rising excitement for using DL techniques in liver research to aid clinicians in diagnosing and treating medical conditions. The Improved Fully Convolutional Neural Network (IFCNN) has been introduced in this study as a solution to the problem of liver tumor segmentation in cases of liver cancer. The IFCNN has been mathematically designed to address this issue. Transfer learning improves the ability to apply knowledge gained from one patient group to other patient groups with different characteristics. Comparative studies performed against ResNet and VGG16 demonstrate higher sensitivity, specificity, and overall classification metrics. The algorithms' efficacy and real-time processing capabilities have been extensively validated on multiple datasets, including different kinds and stages of liver cancer. This paves the way for eventual incorporation into clinical processes. These advanced algorithms exhibit superior precision and efficiency compared to current models, offering significant potential for improving clinical practice. They provide more dependable tools for precise diagnosis and informed treatment planning in the fight against liver cancer.

articleTitle: An Optimized Hybrid Energy Forecasting: Efficient Simulated Chaotic Hormonal Search (SCHS) Model using Hybrid Energy Sources
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Background: Rising energy demand and the high cost of fossil fuels in remote and island areas are driving increased interest in renewable energy sources (RES). These sources, while environmentally friendly, are often unpredictable and intermittent. Hybridization of different RES can help reduce these issues and improve overall system efficiency. Methods: This paper develops an optimization-based weather forecasting method for a hybrid energy system combining solar, wind, and hydrogen storage. The objective is to minimize the Total Life Cycle Cost (TLCC) and Loss of Power Supply Probability (LPSP) of the hybrid energy system. To achieve this, a novel optimization algorithm called Simulated Chaotic Hormonal Search (SCHS) is employed. Additionally, the Intelligent Simulated Neural Network (ISNN) mechanism is used to project a hybrid RES incorporating solar insolation, wind speed, and air temperature. Results: The proposed method optimally meets load demand using three different off-grid hybrid RES. Concluding Remarks: The innovative approach of combining SCHS and ISNN mechanisms provides an effective solution for optimizing hybrid renewable energy systems. The proposed method not only addresses the unpredictability and intermittency of RES but also ensures cost-effectiveness and reliability. The simulation results confirm the potential of this approach in enhancing the performance of hybrid RES in remote and island areas.

articleTitle: An Automated Profession Prediction Application using the Horoscope with Deep Learning-Based Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Astrology is a time-honored and conventional kind of divination that continues to capture people's curiosity. There are no widely accepted rules or astrological prediction principles in the modern world. Astrologers would rather provide excellent services to people without making any guarantees about accuracy than create a set of norms that apply to everyone. Meanwhile, by utilising computers' natural ability to learn, machine learning has shown to be incredibly successful at analysing and forecasting results in a wide range of applications. Learners can manage big, noisy, complex datasets with the help of prediction and classification. The goal of this work is to present a scientific method that emphasises general prediction rules while reducing the drawbacks of the conventional methodology. Three classification methods are used to show that astrology is valid: J48, Logistic-R, and Cursed Gaussian Naïve Bayes. With 10, 12, and 14-fold cross-validation, supervised learning is used to compute a number of metrics, the study also includes the True Positive Rates, False Positive Rates, Precision, and F-Measure statistics. Moreover, true positive rate, false positive rate, accuracy, F-measure, PRC, and ROC area are used to calculate the mean weight of the three class labels—doctor, businessman, and professor. In order to determine which classification strategy performs better, the precision of each method is finally computed and compared. The birthday details (date, location, and timing) of one hundred people from various occupations are gathered in order to carry out this study. Thirty businessmen, thirty physicians, and forty professors are represented in the dataset. Software is used to create each person's horoscope, and a datasheet in.csv format is produced for analysis. Next, the dataset is used in the Weka programme to assess different parameters and get each classifier's accuracy.

articleTitle: An Unified Trio-Biometric Authentication Systems: Optimized NeuroFusionNet (OENF-Net) And HMVW Optimizer
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: This research introduces the deep learning-based methodology of the multimodal biometric system (Trio-biometric recognition) utilizing ears, cuticles and eye-sockets, as the distinct identifiers. This methodology contains the validation phase and the enrolment phase. While on enrolment, the high-quality images for ears, cuticles, and eye-sockets, were acquired and pre-processed to clear visibility and consistent illumination for features. By using an inception V3 model, the features extracted, and then they are stored with the database (cloud). In a validation phase, the images for ears, cuticles, or eye-sockets are acquired. Moreover, Authentication are performed by using a new optimized NeuroFusionNet (ONF-Net), whose weights are optimized using the new Multi-Verse Grasshopper Whale Optimizer (HMVW). An OENF-Net determines whether an individual is authenticated or not. This proposed approach enhances the robustness and accuracy with biometric authentication. On combination of ears, cuticles, and eye-sockets as multimodal identifiers and using the deep learning techniques and optimized RBFNs, the efficient and comprehensive authentication framework (with accuracy of 94.3%) are achieved.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Analysis of Security Mechanisms Against SQL Injection Across Diverse Database Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: This report explores a variety of different security measures that aim to stop an SQL injection attacks among several database types including relational, graph, wide column, key-value and document stores. SQL injection attacks still represent an important threat that can lead to unauthorized access, data breaches and serious operational disruptions. The author examines parameters queries as well as input validation and access control techniques in light of their ability to avoid SQL injection while at the same time weighing performance against scalability. Security practices for databases like Neo4j, Cassandra, Redis, MongoDB, and Oracle assert that higher level security measures need to be combined with effective operations. However code comparisons combined with testing results demonstrate how safety issues are handled by each DBM which is then followed by suggestions for improvement in future moments for database technology

articleTitle: A Novel Method for Classifying and Detecting Kidney Stone using MRI based on CNN and Attention Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: When training neural networks, the Back Propagation Network approach is frequently employed. It uses data and images to construct an automated kidney stone classification system. Classification of medical MRI kidney imaging and identification of stones typically involves human assessment. Due of the impracticality of dealing with massive data volumes, this technique is incorrect. Operator error is a potential source of noise contamination in Magnetic Resonance (MR) images. This leads to serious problems with image processing and inaccurate classification characteristics. On the other hand, the use AI, NN, and feature extraction to isolate the target area using back propagation network analysis has yielded impressive results. The objective of this endeavor was to detect kidney stones by use of the Back Propagation Network. In order to accomplish this, data image preprocessing acquires a framework, reduces noise, and removes bed-mats. area, volume of area, and stone's surface area are utilized for feature extraction after the momentum phrase and R<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">proper</inf> term are employed for picture segmentation. All three of these models—CNN, LSTM, and AGCNN-LSTM were utilized to train the projected model. With a 96% accuracy rate, the suggested model surpassed its predecessor.

Author Keywords: Attention Enhanced Graph Convolution Neural Network - Long Short term Memory (AGCNN -LSTM)

articleTitle: Accelerated Cancer Prediction in WBAN with Markov Transition Field and U-net+ Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Background-In the field of cancer prediction and surveillance, the combination of Wireless Body Area Networks (WBANs) and advanced machine learning techniques has shown significant promise recently. Comprising an array of wearable sensors, WBANs continuously collect physiological and activity data from patients in a non-invasive manner. However, there is a significant issue in converting these univariate time sequence data into a format that is simpler to comprehend and examine. Methods-To address the issue of transforming univariate to bivariate time sequence data, we built new model termed as MTF-UX model. We apply the Markov Transition Field (MTF) technique to transform the univariate time sequence data collected by WBANs into bivariate time sequence pictures. These MTF-generated images are fed into the subsequent deep learning system. For the predictive modeling, we make use of an improved U-Net architecture known as U-Net+.Results-With additional layers and modified settings, an improved version of U-Net improves both the accuracy and robustness of cancer prediction. The results demonstrate that a dense layer of [256,128,64] and an image size of 256 x 256 produced the greatest results in terms of accuracy, F1 score, AUC, and MCC_UX, which were 98.46%, 94.26%, 95.00%, and 96.58%, correspondingly.Concluding Remarks-The Markov Transition Field (MTF) approach, enhanced U-Net architecture (U-Net+), and WBANs are utilized in this work to present a novel model for accurate and early cancer prediction called the "MTF-UX model". WBANs, MTF, and U-Net+ together offer a potent framework attaining excellent prediction accuracy, accurate tracking, and providing insightful information about patient health.

articleTitle: Improving Skin Lesion Diagnosis Employing Attention-Based LSTM Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Diagnosing skin lesions is, therefore, an exercise full of challenges even for the most seasoned dermatologists, more so when several factors are present. Examples of features about this condition include the minimal variation between healthy and tumor skin and the high level of similarity among different types of skin lesions, sometimes coupled with blurred edges of the lesion. The merits of this involve the help that it accrues to a physician trying to achieve accuracy at very early stages in malignant skin lesion detection, with an automated computer-aided detection system trained on a dataset consisting of images. Indeed, because of recent developments in deep learning, it is at this moment that new techniques, such as dilated convolution, have recently been introduced. Concerning conventional ConvNets, these claim better accuracy with identical, similar levels of computational complexity. We are introducing a method of classification of skin lesions based on an attention-based long short-term memory network in this paper. The proposed methodology was inspired from the source of attention mechanisms in people's visual systems. These mechanisms concentrate on the essential parts of an image and filter away auditory information, which is not eventually indispensable to an image from what the human 'visual' system has to attend to. When compared to the existing approaches proposed technique achieves with an accuracy of 96.93%.

articleTitle: Real-Time Versatile Object Detection With High Accuracy And Reduced Information Loss During Wartime
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Real time object detection models can quickly scan camera feeds or drone footage, which automatically detect and classify objects, to identify potential threats like enemy combatants, vehicles, or weapons through constantly updating battlefield pictures. Existing methods ignore the need for open vocabulary detection, and some models struggle with information loss during data processing. In this paper, we attempted to identify real-time, highly versatile, and accurate object detection by its strengths and ability to address information loss by adopting SPPELAN module. The proposal system detects the open vocabulary using CLIP encoder as language vision model and modified C2f-darknet for fusing visual features and vocabulary embeddings and Path Aggregation Network is used to create multiple pathways to focus on different aspects of the screen to achieve higher parameter usage. Proposed a state-of-art system with natural language supervision for vocabulary learning. We evaluated the performance of our system on a publicly available Microsoft Coco dataset. The proposed methodology detects the accurate region according to the given vocabulary without losing data effectively.

articleTitle: An Explorative Analysis of Detection and Controlling of Security in IOT Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: The devices used in networks are simple targets for attacks, because they disseminate data over wireless means. IoT security is a more difficult and complex issue as a result of the uniqueness and spread of IoT applications. Hence, to overcome this condition, a data-driven and anomaly-based methodology known as Deep Learning (DL) technique is employed. The DL technique possess the capacity to identify newly developing and unidentified attacks, also offers cutting edge solutions for IoT intrusion detection. The DL models used in IoT security attack are thoroughly reviewed in this paper. Moreover, implementing security protocols like encrypting, identification, security systems, network monitoring, and data protection for IoT devices and its flaws are also taken into account. Furthermore, a comprehensive examination is conducted amid the DL methodologies and ongoing breakthroughs in DL methods that are utilised to create better attack classifier model for IoT networks.

articleTitle: Chronic Kidney Disease Prediction Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) stands as a pervasive and critical renal condition, posing a substantial global health challenge. Each kidney comprises nephrons, the essential filtration units that help to filter the blood and extract the waste products. Individuals with type 2 diabetes or high blood pressure face an elevated risk of renal failure. Predicting renal failure at an early stage remains challenging due to the absence of specific symptoms, leading to severe long-term consequences, including mortality. This paper aims to comprehensively analyze and assess the efficacy of predictive models for CKD, using various Machine Learning Classification Algorithms. The classifiers such as K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Decision Tree (DT), Random Forest (RF), Naïve Bayes (NB), and Gradient Boosting (GB). Out of all the classifiers Random Forest and Gradient Boosting produced the best accuracy result compared to other classifiers. This research extends the investigation by providing a nuanced analysis of the significance of machine learning techniques in predicting CKD, emphasizing their role in early detection and prognosis. This research includes a detailed comparison of accuracy scores and, a confusion matrix to identify correct and incorrect features, thereby facilitating a comprehensive examination and analysis of machine learning algorithms. The evaluation utilizes accuracy, precision, recall, and f1-score to detect the optimal model.

articleTitle: Comparison of Hybrid Deep Learning Model for Cyclone Prediction from Raw Satellite Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Background: Satellite image classification plays a crucial role in weather forecasting and climate analysis. It has been a focal point of attention for remote sensing communities for decades, particularly in cyclone classification. Deep Learning (DL) techniques have shown promising results in image processing. Proper cyclone identification helps to avoid damage to society and humans.Methods: In this study, we propose a method to classify cyclone types based on raw satellite images. To achieve reliable results, we propose hybrid DL models, including Convolutional Neural Network - Long Short-Term Memory (CNN-LSTM), Convolutional Neural Network - Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (CNN-BiLSTM), and Convolutional Neural Network - Gated Recurrent Unit (CNN-GRU). We utilized publicly available satellite images from Kaggle for model training and validation. Raw images underwent various processing techniques to boost the performance of the hybrid DL models.Results: Three hybrid DL models were tested using 50 satellite images, and performance metrics were utilized for evaluation. Experimental results show that the proposed CNN-BiLSTM model outperforms CNN-LSTM and CNN-GRU, achieving an accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score of 98%, 99%, 98%, and 99%, respectively.Conclusion: The proposed CNN-BiLSTM model shows superior performance in cyclone classification. The outcome of the proposed model proves that it will be very useful for effective weather forecasting and climate analysis applications.

articleTitle: Low Power FPGA Implementation of ECG monitoring in WBAN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: In smart healthcare, independent ECG devices with an Internet of Things foundation are becoming commonplace for identifying and averting cardiovascular disorders. Nevertheless, since these systems frequently run on batteries, transmission connections with high power consumption might drastically shorten their total operating life. This study suggests a power management approach and related VLSI design to improve the longevity of battery-operated Internet of Things ECG monitoring devices in order to solve this problem. Depending on the battery’s energy level, the suggested approach dynamically switches between high-power and low-power transmission modes. For on-node localized processing, a lightweight technique with a runtime adaptive thresholding focus on slope improvement is presented. This algorithm allows for real-time QRS complex recognition and heart rate evaluation while optimizing power consumption in low battery conditions. By effectively gathering enough ECG data from a single patient and prolonging system lifespan, the suggested system satisfies the objective of Wireless Body Area Network (WBAN) systems by intelligently choosing the suitable transmission mode depending on battery level and heart rate stability. Using the MIT-BIH arrhythmia database, the algorithm’s sensitivity and predictivity were evaluated; 99.35% sensitivity and 99.38% predictivity were obtained. With a maximum clock frequency of 269 MHz and a power consumption of only 0.7 mW, the Spartan-6 FPGA was used to build the design, which made it appropriate for real-time ECG monitoring. IoT-based ECG monitoring systems may now operate more efficiently and last longer thanks to the suggested power management approach and VLSI design, which increases their suitability for real-time healthcare applications.

articleTitle: Crypto Prophets: Machine Learning Oracles for Price Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Cryptocurrency has emerged as a revolutionary financial asset, captivating investors and researchers alike with its volatile nature and potential for high returns. As the market continues to evolve, there is an increasing need for sophisticated tools to predict price movements and inform investment decisions. This research work delves into a predictive assessment of cryptocurrency price fluctuations, using thorough machine learning techniques to project future prices for Monero, Ethereum, Wrapped Bitcoin, and Bitcoin—the four leading cryptocurrencies. Using historical price data, our methodology includes data preprocessing, feature selection, and the application of various machine learning models such as Linear Regression, Extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Random Forest, and Support Vector Regression (SVR). The models’ predictive performance was meticulously evaluated using Mean Squared Error (MSE), R-squared (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>), and Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE). Linear Regression achieved superior performance for Bitcoin with an R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> score of 0.9823 and Wrapped Bitcoin with an R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> score of 0.9780, while XG-Boost excelled in Monero predictions with the lowest MSE of 325.33. This research offers critical insights for investors, market strategists, and financial analysts, underscoring the prominent impact of machine learning in enhancing the market analysis of cryptocurrencies and informing decision-making processes. The work immensely contributes to the flourishing area of financial technology, suggesting various ways to move forward with integrated advanced predictive models and sentiment analysis of markets and economic indicators to redefine investment strategies in the highly volatile cryptocurrency domain.

articleTitle: Gene Array Based Cervical cancer categorization with Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Cervical squamous cell carcinoma is anticipated to become the fourth most prevalent cancer globally and is expected to cause the death of one in three affected women. The World Health Organization (WHO) reports that 86% of all documented cases of cervical cancer occur in developing countries.. Gene expression profiling is still used extensively in the investigation of cervical cancer. Gene expression patterns have been investigated in biological networks, in particular a gene co-expression network, which emerges as an unconventional comprehensive method for microarray research. A component of the physiognomy in gene co-expression networks continues to be disproportionate even at the point in time when a particular biological issue has been addressed.Initially, the Enhanced Bacterial colony Optimization Algorithm with Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion (EBCO-HSIC) and the Support Vector Machine (SVM) method are bestowed in this investigation by selecting symbolic genes that encompass phases including normalisation, module detection, gene selection, and classification. The gene dataset is first percolated using the fuzzy C Means (FCM) approach, which is then used for both the purpose of normalisation and the removal of extraneous features. The EBO method is used in order to choose the suitable genes using the degree of accuracy in categorization as the fitness function. The approach that was devised focuses on gene importance as well as calibrating the dependence between differentially expressed genes (DEGs) in order to arbitrate a selection of the most informative genes by using an ultrafast beyond ascendable bat algorithm. In order to remedy this situation, HSIC, which is supported in part by EBO, is put into action. The SVM classifier is an effective tool for categorising high-dimensional data, such as that obtained from microarray gene expression.

articleTitle: Solar Power Output Prediction with AI: Leveraging Meta Learner Ensemble Stacked Regressor
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: As the world shifts from fossil fuels to renewable energy, solar power has become essential in meeting global energy demands. The efficiency of solar energy depends on effectively capturing the environmental and physical factors that impact electricity production by solar panels. This study aims to leverage available data on power output and environmental conditions to build advanced machine learning models for predicting solar power. Models such as KNN, DNN, LGBM, RF, and a Meta Learner will be rigorously trained and fine-tuned using various data subsets and hyperparameter optimization. By employing the stacking regressor module from Scikit-learn, a Python machine-learning library, we successfully combined four distinct models, achieving an R-squared value of 0.68 in predicting solar power. This method not only improves the accuracy of solar power predictions but also enhances our ability to capture the complex data relationships critical for forecasting renewable energy.

articleTitle: An Innovative Method for Stress Detection in Social Network Messages Based on GA and DT-SVM Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Many mental health illnesses can affect a person's mood, behavior, emotions, and thoughts. In terms of public health around the world, this is a big deal. An attempt is being made to examine social media posts for indicators of stress and depressive tendencies; this should help with the early detection of mental health illnesses. Preprocessing the model text, feature extraction, and training make up the three phases described by the method. Tokenization, stemming, data standardization, emoji translation, and stop word removal are some of the procedures involved in text pre-processing. In this proposed it how to extract features for ocular validation using principal component analysis (PCA) and latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA). A GA-DT-SVM was used to train the model. The proposed approach works better than GA and SVM, with an average accuracy of 92.07%.

articleTitle: Autonomous Android Malware Detection System Based on Static Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Security measures for Android-powered devices are necessary to prevent sophisticated and malicious assaults. This entails creating automated systems capable of anticipating, identifying, and removing dangerous Android apps.Static analysis and feature engineering are used to train Long Short-Term Memory networks for malware detection once Android programs have been extracted.The information is somewhat outdated and less than 80% of the facts are true. To address these issues, the initiative offers a novel technique for Android malware detection and classification and uses static analysis to recover pertinent data. To help machine learning algorithms understand different malware types, specialized datasets are collected and standardized into a common format.The Long Short-Term Memory technique is used to recognize and classify Android malware. Two more suggestions are made by the study, which analyzes data using a functional API deep learning model. To develop accurate and targeted detection algorithms, researchers collect specialized datasets for several types of malware (such as ransomware, scarware, adware, and SMS malware). Features that can be created from raw malware data include opcode sequences, Application Programming Interface calls, and n-grams. These features can also be obtained from code or behavioral logs. Using scaling and normalizing to make sure the extracted features have comparable ranges and magnitudes improves the performance of machine learning models.Accurate and effective malware detection models are created by applying static analysis techniques such as disassembling the Android Package Kit and inspecting the byte code for known malware signatures.

articleTitle: Dynamic Feature Selection Algorithm for Enhanced Time-Series Energy Consumption Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Accurate power intake projecting is essential for enhancing power source administration, lowering power expenses and also preparing for future power demands. Because of solar power's intermittent nature coupled with minimal ability to handle solar problems grid drivers worldwide have a hard time to efficiently incorporate solar power right into the system to meet present need. This requires a thorough service to properly anticipate as well as take care of solar energy radiation as well as generation, attending to the progressing characteristics of supply as well as need on the grid. The purpose of the job is to produce a Artificial Intelligence (AI) design for exact forecast of solar energy radiation coupled with generation, along with improved power intake projecting by utilizing vibrant attributes to enhance flexibility and also precision. The method includes numerous artificial intelligence formulas from monitored set understanding coupled with deep discovering groups for maximized projecting. The datasets for radiation as well as generation have actually been sourced from Kaggle's system. The very best precision has actually been acquired from the Linear Regression for radiation is 97.75 together with the Random Forest Regression for generation is 91.99.By employing SARIMAX, the system aims to capture the complex temporal dynamics inherent in energy consumption data, thereby enabling precise forecasting of future consumption patterns. The optimized forecasting model facilitates improved decision-making for solar power generation scheduling, resource allocation, and grid integration, ultimately contributing to the advancement of sustainable energy systems.

articleTitle: Analysis of Vedic Multipliers Using Various Adders and Reversible Logic - Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Multiplication is one of the main functions of a digital signal processing system. The performance of the multiplier impacts the total performance of the DSP system. Thus, setting up the necessary infrastructure for the prompt and efficient installation of multipliers is essential. Vedic mathematics can help make difficult-to-solve complex situations easier to understand. The multiplication algorithm is called Urdhva Triyagbhyam in Vedic mathematics. These days, reversible logic is widely used in a wide range of applications, including optical data processing, multipliers, low-power CMOS circuits, and quantum circuits. Vedic mathematics mixed with reversible logic yields powerful multipliers. Using reversible logic in conjunction with well-known logical concepts such as basic adders and parallel prefix adders. Registers are organized in a pipeline to further accelerate the computation of multiplication. N-bit adders and N/2 Vedic multipliers come together to generate the N-bit Vedic multipliers. The designs are simulated and synthesized with Xilinx and the EDA tool after being programmed in Verilog HDL. In terms of speed, the Vedic multipliers function better.

articleTitle: A Novel SynergyXLBi Model to Predict Personality Trait From Text Conversation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Social media platforms serve as powerful tools for communication and promoting justice worldwide. Nevertheless, identifying trustworthy individuals and assessing strangers on social media within a short time frame can be challenging. Deriving personality traits from digital content requires mapping textual data to a personality model. The widely accepted personality assessment model is based on the Big Five traits; however, existing algorithms like Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) have limitations. To predict personality traits, we utilize bidirectional context features and extraction methods with transformer-based models. Our proposed model, Novel SynergyXLBi, combines the capabilities of Bidirectional LSTM (BiLSTM), Generalized Autoregressive Pretraining for Language Understanding (XLNet) and Conditional Random Fields (CRF). It extracts features and leverages Named Entity Recognition (NER) to classify the Five Personality Traits (OCEAN). Experimental results demonstrate that the Novel SynergyXLBi model achieves an accuracy of 97.32%, precision of 97.21%, recall of 97.24%, and an F1-score of 97.11% when compared to Random Forest, K-Nearest Neighbors, Decision Tree, and K-means classifier models. We evaluated the performance using two state-of-the-art corpora namely CoNLL-2003 and WNUT-2017, and found that the proposed Novel SynergyXLBi model surpasses the performance of existing models.

articleTitle: Smart IoT-Based Water Quality Monitoring: Real-Time Assessment and Predictive Analytics with Advanced Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Water quality monitoring is crucial for maintaining safe and clean water sources for both human use and environmental health. This study introduces an innovative water quality monitoring system that combines state-of-the-art sensor technology, wireless communication, and advanced data analytics to provide real-time assessments of water quality. The system employs strategically placed sensor nodes to continuously measure critical parameters, including pH, turbidity, temperature, and conductivity. By utilizing various technologies, the system effectively analyzes the collected data to detect trends, identify anomalies, and predict potential pollution events. This approach supports early detection of water quality issues, enabling timely and informed interventions to protect aquatic ecosystems and human health. The design integrates Microcontroller-Based sensors, a variety of environmental sensors, and advanced analytical techniques for a comprehensive water quality management solution.

articleTitle: Pattern-Aware Indoor Semantic Segmentation Based on Visual Optimization Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Semantic segmentation of indoor scenes plays a pivotal role in various applications such as indoor navigation systems, creating detailed and accurate indoor maps, and optimizing route planning for both humans and robots. However, effectively integrating RGB (color) and HHA (depth) images for indoor semantic segmentation poses both promise and challenge due to the diverse textures and structures present in indoor environments, coupled with the varying significance of different modalities. Traditionally, tasks like semantic segmentation and depth estimation have been treated as separate entities in computer vision. However, recent advancements in research have explored the potential benefits of combining these tasks into a unified framework. The rationale behind this exploration lies in the inherent correlation between semantic understanding and depth perception, suggesting that integrating these tasks could lead to more accurate estimations. Our approach diverges from conventional segmentation methods by proposing the integration of two neural network models to achieve precise semantic segmentation specifically tailored for mobile robot mapping applications. Initially, we employ a model to identify salient objects within the scene, which are then delineated in grayscale. Subsequently, the contours of these salient objects, along with their semantic labels, are projected onto the corresponding RGB image, resulting in the segmentation of important objects within the indoor environment. By focusing on salient objects rather than considering the entirety of the scene, our method streamlines the segmentation process, simplifying the consideration of background elements. This targeted approach is particularly advantageous in scenarios where efficient and accurate segmentation of relevant objects is paramount, such as in robotic navigation tasks within complex indoor environments.

articleTitle: Sparsity-Aware Multi-Agent RL-Random Access Protocol using Grant Free for Massive MIMO Networks in Cellular IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Cellular Internet of Things (IoT) devices greatly benefit from the incorporation of large Multiple Input Multiple Output (MIMO) networks in terms of connectivity and information processing. Effective and reliable random access techniques face challenges due to the increased density of IoT devices and the irregularity of their transmissions. Conventional grant-based access mechanisms are ineffective in high-density IoT environments due to higher signaling costs and delays. While they require less communication, grant-free random access techniques struggle with managing interference and collisions, especially in large MIMO settings. This research aims to develop a sparsity-aware, grant-free randomization technique using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) to improve the efficiency of large MIMO systems in cellular IoT applications. The main objectives are to enhance access efficiency, reduce collision rates, and effectively manage interference. In the proposed technique, each IoT device acts as an agent within a MARL framework. Computational findings show that the sparsity-aware, MARL-based, grant-free random access protocols significantly outperform conventional approaches in terms of connection success probability, delay, and overall network performance. In dense IoT environments, the proposed protocol effectively handles conflicts and interference, resulting in more reliable and efficient communications. The implementation of a sparsity-aware, grant-free randomization method based on MARL in cellular IoT improves the efficiency of large MIMO networks. This approach addresses critical issues of interference control and connectivity efficiency, paving the way for further advancements in cellular IoT communications.

articleTitle: Develop Improved Weighed Quantum Particle Swarm Optimization for Distributed MIMO and NOMA Systems in Energy Harvesting Mobile-Edge Computing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Due to the complex nature of the goal function in meeting demands that ensure sufficient Quality of Service (QoS), such as minimizing the number of determined bits, limiting the total power consumption by users, maximizing CPU speed, ensuring minimum harvested power, and managing computation times, the problem is non-convex and difficult to solve. Mobile Edge Computing (MEC) represents a significant digital transformation trend that addresses issues associated with cloud computing. However, implementing Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) MEC networks is challenging due to underlying power and bandwidth constraints. This article proposes a new approach to optimize dynamic resource planning and energy efficiency in MEC environments. Specifically, it focuses on power distribution in Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) and Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) systems using the Improved Weighted Quantum Particle Swarm Optimization (IWQPSO) method. The proposed approach leverages the unique capabilities of IWQPSO to tackle the intricate, non- linear optimization problems inherent in these systems. By incorporating quantum computing principles, the IWQPSO method enhances convergence speed and solution accuracy, leading to more efficient use of energy harvesting. The research demonstrates significant improvements in resource planning and power allocation efficiency, enhancing overall system performance. Simulation results validate the success of the proposed strategy, highlighting substantial energy savings and improved resource management in future wireless networks.

Author Keywords: Improved Weighted Quantum Particle Swarm Optimization

articleTitle: Migration Technique from Traditional Database to Blockchain Database
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: This study presents a software solution that tackles traditional databases' vulnerability to cyberattacks by exploiting the security aspects of blockchain technology. The solution includes a migration tool to help web2 developers convert from traditional databases to blockchain databases, as well as a REST-based API endpoint to make the process easier. As blockchain databases become more extensively used, the proposed solution might have a substantial impact on the economy and technology, potentially lowering the risks and costs associated with cyberattacks while increasing need for competent workers in this field. The report describes the solution's design and implementation, as well as its potential benefits and limits. Because of their centralised structure, traditional databases, including relational and NoSQL databases, are vulnerable to cyberattacks. As a result, a more secure option to managing sensitive data is required. This system would rely on the security properties of blockchain, which isolate and authenticate each transaction within a block. The proposed approach could have a huge economic and technological impact. As blockchain databases gain popularity, the demand for qualified people in this field is expected to rise. Furthermore, this technology has the potential to help businesses better protect critical data, thus lowering the risks and expenses connected to cyberattacks.The proposed solution is a migration tool that facilitates the transition from traditional databases to blockchain databases. This tool will allow businesses to easily make the switch, while also providing them with the added security benefits of blockchain technology. The REST-based API endpoint will make it easy for web2 developers to implement the migration process and reduce the development cost drastically.

articleTitle: Improving Diagnosis and Classification of Severity in Diabetic Retinopathy Using Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: One of the most severe consequences of diabetes mellitus is diabetic retinopathy, which causes degeneration of blood vessels in the retina and blindness. The deadly effect of the described disease can be potentially prevented or addressed if detection and treatment measures are undertaken timely. The recent implementation of deep learning (DL) approaches in analyzing massive and complicated data has had a transformative effect of the sphere of medical image analysis. Being capable of recognizing the tiniest features and specifics of the retina, these methods enable highly complicated, efficient detection and classification algorithms. This paper provides a detailed description of the methodology for classifying the level of DR severity using retinal scans from Kaggle. The timeliness of the above response is explained by the urgency of DR detection and treatment measures. It should be noted that a specifically arranged data set was created in the described work, including 2750 pictures in with 5 groups of severity. The maximum training accuracy of 98.55% was reached by using EfficientNetB3 with transfer learning, and the validation and testing accuracies constituted 71.27% and 76.36%, respectively.

articleTitle: Towards Optimized and Empirical Evaluation of Brain Tumor Segmentation Using Kernel Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Brain tumors, which are highlighted by the development of cells with the potential to become a tumor that is provide a considerable medical obstacle. Gliomas, which develop as a result glial cells, have a very unfavorable prognosis. Early and precise detection is vital for several reasons, including the short average lifespan of less than 14 months following a glioblastoma diagnosis. Fortunately, Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) provides a secure and comprehensive visualization of brain tissue, which is useful in assisting in the detection of tumors. Historically, extensively trained experts diligently examined these images, which was a laborious and time-consuming the law. Advancements in learning algorithms enabling segmentation to be automated. A significant challenge in previous neural network models was the inability to retain important position and spatial information in the deeper levels. The way we propose addresses this difficulty by including a Feature Enhancer block. In additional, we tackle the problem of imbalanced classes, where the data does not include an equal representation of healthy and malignant tissues. The utilization of our custom-designed loss processes guarantees that the model allocates greater focus on the tumor class that is under-represented, resulting in a more equitable analysis. The results proposed architecture exhibits substantial enhancement in comparison to current methodologies. Our technique provides outstanding performance in MRI brain tumor segmentation by utilizing advanced location and spatial information. This facilitates the possibility of achieving more precise and effective identification of cancerous cells, ultimately contributing to improve the patient's findings.

articleTitle: AI-Powered Risk Management Solutions in the Banking Sector: A Data-Driven Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: In the rapidly evolving financial sector, the need for advanced fraud detection mechanisms is increasingly critical. This research paper assesses the efficacy of different artificial intelligence (AI) models in real-time fraud detection within financial institutions. The study involves evaluating three AI models—Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM), Random Forest Classifier, and Deep Learning Neural Networks—to determine their effectiveness in identifying fraudulent transactions and operational irregularities. By analyzing critical performance metrics such as precision, real-time detection speed, F1-score, and recall, the research seeks to uncover the advantages and limitations of each model. Model 1 evaluates the efficacy in identifying anomalies and potential fraudulent activities within a controlled environment. Model 2 focuses on real-time fraud detection, assessing the models' capacity to precisely categorize transactions as fraudulent or non-fraudulent. Model 3 examines performance under various operational conditions, including normal transaction loads, high transaction volumes, and periods of elevated fraudulent activity. The findings reveal that Deep Learning Neural Networks outperform other models in terms of recall and precision, demonstrating superior capabilities in detecting complex patterns of fraud. Although Deep Learning models exhibit longer detection times, their accuracy in identifying true positives and minimizing false negatives underscores their effectiveness. In contrast, the Random Forest Classifier and GBM, while effective, show limitations in precision and recall compared to Deep Learning models. The research contributes to the understanding of AI applications in fraud detection and provides actionable insights for financial institutions seeking to enhance their detection capabilities.

articleTitle: Flourishing Fields: Modernizing Farming with Real Time AI-powered Tomato Disease Detection and Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: The agricultural sector faces significant challenges due to plant diseases, which can drastically reduce crop yields and quality. This paper presents a cutting-edge solution for real-time detection and instant remediation of tomato plant diseases using a web-based interface. Leveraging deep learning models and advanced image processing techniques, our system accurately identifies ten distinct tomato diseases from leaf images. The core of the system is built using TensorFlow and OpenCV, and it operates through a user-friendly interface developed with Streamlit. This interface not only detects diseases in real-time but also provides actionable solutions, recommending specific fertilizers and treatment protocols. This holistic approach will pinpoint the location of infected crops, apply targeted treatments, and monitor the effectiveness of interventions. By harnessing technology, we aspire to empower farmers with timely information and tools to enhance crop health, reduce losses, and increase agricultural productivity. Our initial focus on tomatoes provides a robust framework that can be adapted to other crops, paving the way for smarter, more resilient agricultural practices.

articleTitle: Advancements and Security Challenges in the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT)
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: This paper explores the significant advancements in IIoT, focusing on the increased efficiency, productivity, and innovation brought about by interconnected industrial systems. Despite the numerous benefits, the paper also delves into the critical security challenges inherent in IIoT deployments. These include vulnerabilities in network infrastructure, potential cyber-attacks targeting industrial control systems, and data privacy concerns stemming from the vast amounts of sensitive information generated. The analysis highlights the necessity for robust cybersecurity measures, including advanced encryption, intrusion detection systems, and secure communication protocols. This report offers a thorough assessment of the current status of IIoT technology by looking at both the opportunities and threats related to it. It offers insights into best practices and emerging solutions aimed at mitigating security threats, ensuring a secure and resilient industrial ecosystem. The paper concludes by discussing future directions for research and development, emphasizing the importance of a multidisciplinary approach to addressing the complex challenges and unlocking the full potential of IIoT.

articleTitle: Deep Learning for Emoji Generation: From Faces and Gestures to Digital Emotion
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: The objective of this project is to create a reliable and effective system for identifying facial expressions and hand movements and translating them into suitable emojis. Emotions are vital in human communication, and precisely understanding them may significantly improve user experiences in several applications, such as social media, virtual assistants, and human-computer interaction. Through the creation of an extensive dataset and the use of a robust CNN, the system is capable of precisely categorizing facial expressions, even when faced with different lighting conditions and a wide range of facial characteristics. The suggested methodology entails the acquisition of live video data, which is then subjected to preprocessing to enhance the extraction of relevant features. Subsequently, CNN models are used to accurately recognize and interpret facial emotions and movements. These acknowledged phrases are then converted into equivalent emojis, offering an instinctive and smooth method to communicate emotions via digital communication. Initial findings indicate that the system attains a notable level of precision in identifying a diverse array of facial emotions, showcasing its capacity for practical use in real-life scenarios. This study enhances the field of human-computer interaction by facilitating a more authentic and articulate form of communication via emojis. It effectively narrows the divide between human emotions and digital interfaces. Subsequent efforts will concentrate on augmenting the system's functionalities to include a wider array of motions and improving its efficiency in more demanding settings.

articleTitle: A Secure and Efficient Key Management for Intrusion Detection In Cloud Storage Based On PLS And SVM Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Cloud computing, a novel way of storing and processing data, has become an essential tool for many individuals very soon. With the proliferation of AI and big data, it is now standard practice in manufacturing to employ these technologies to discover novel approaches to enhancing decision-making or to accelerate production. This proposed method consists of three phases: preprocessing, feature extraction, and model training. The goal of text preprocessing is to enhance the quality and utility of the text data so that it is better suited for additional analysis or modeling. Equations such as symmetric uncertainty, gain ratio, IG, chi-squared, and other filter-based feature selection approaches are employed for feature selection. We used a PLS-SVM to train the model. The proposed methodology outshines more traditional methods. After using the strategy, the accuracy was enhanced by 95.43%.

articleTitle: SRMDent: Dental Carries Segmentation using Residual Attention U-Net for Orthopantomogram Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: This study developed an automated deep learning model, the Residual Attention U-Net (RAU-Net), to enhance dental caries diagnosis through improved segmentation. Our approach boosts computing efficiency and feature capture by integrating residual learning and attention mechanisms. Our new dataset, SRMDent, contains 1130 orthopantomogram (OPG) images from SRM Dental College, meticulously analyzed and annotated for cavities. The model was trained using a binary cross-entropy loss function and the Adam optimizer, with early stopping and learning rate reduction to mitigate overfitting. Evaluation metrics, including the Dice and Jaccard coefficients, indicated that the Residual Attention U-Net significantly improved segmentation performance, highlighting its potential to advance dental diagnosis. Additionally, a comparative study was conducted with various U-Net models, including the standard U-Net, Attention U-Net (AU-Net), and Residual Attention U-Net (RAU-Net). The proposed model outperformed the others, demonstrating its effectiveness in accurate and efficient caries detection, with a Mean IoU of 0.1712. For future work, we plan to expand the SRMDent dataset and further explore the integration of 3D imaging to enhance the accuracy and reliability of dental caries detection.

articleTitle: Alzheimer’s Diseases Detection by Using Xception Deep Neural Network with Data Augmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: In our modern age, amidst the whirlwind of progress and change, there exists a silent epidemic that transcends time and technology, affecting individuals and families in profound ways: Alzheimer’s disease. This illness, which slowly causes memory loss and difficulty thinking, reminds us how delicate our minds are and how complex brain health can be. This work focuses on leveraging deep learning algorithms with data augmentation to enhance the accuracy of AD detection. The study examines four cutting-edge deep learning models: Xception, InceptionV3, EfficientNetB3, and ResNet50. Robust feature extraction from MRI images is accomplished by using ResNet50, which is renowned for its deep design with skip connections. EfficientNetB3, with its efficient design and high accuracy, contributes to effective classification of AD stages. InceptionV3’s multi-level feature extraction capabilities are utilized to capture intricate patterns indicative of AD progression. Xception’s depth wise separable convolutions enhance pattern recognition, aiding in precise disease detection. Utilizing deep learning algorithms, notably Xception, and employing data augmentation techniques, our study attained an exceptional accuracy of 97.18% in detecting Alzheimer’s Disease, utilizing the "Alzheimer’s Diseases Detection" dataset. In order to improve early diagnosis and treatment planning for Alzheimer’s patients, the research intends to give a thorough examination of these deep learning methods in AD detection.

articleTitle: Cloud-Enabled K-Means Clustering for Advancing Wildlife Disease Surveillance and Outbreak Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: The preservation of wildlife and the protection of public health depend on accurate disease monitoring and the ability to predict outbreaks. Advanced computational approaches are necessary since traditional methods struggle to handle massive data sets and the need for real-time analysis. An improved approach for monitoring animal diseases using cloud computing and K-Means clustering is proposed in this research. The method takes use of the scalability of cloud computing to handle massive amounts of data on wildlife health gathered from many sensors. Clustering this data using the K-Means technique to see trends and outliers that might be signs of disease outbreaks. The identification and prediction of wildlife disease outbreaks was greatly enhanced using the cloud-enabled K-Means clustering technology. When compared to more traditional methods, the system's ability to identify epidemics and detect patterns in disease transmission was significantly better. Quicker reaction times, which are essential for timely interventions, were made possible by real-time analytic capabilities. To improve the precision of disease monitoring and outbreak prediction, this method also yields useful data for conservation efforts. The new system is a major step forward in the industry, offering improved and timely management of wildlife health.

articleTitle: Security Enhancements in Edge-Based Healthcare with Lightweight Encryption & NDN Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: The burgeoning field of edge-based remote healthcare demands innovative security solutions to protect sensitive patient information while maintaining operational efficiency. This review paper explores the development and enhancement of security frameworks through the implementation of lightweight encryption techniques, specifically designed to mitigate computational overhead in resource-constrained environments. Furthermore, the integration of Named Data Networking (NDN) technology within these frameworks is examined, highlighting its potential to fortify security protocols, reduce communication costs, and achieve higher throughput. Utilizing the Automatic Verification of Web Security Protocols and Applications (AVISPA) tool, which provides an exhaustive assessment of the effectiveness of various combined approaches, the success of such methods is evaluated. By synthesizing recent advancements and evaluating their practical implications, this paper aims to present a thorough overview of current strategies and future directions in securing edge-based remote healthcare systems.

articleTitle: Detecting Depression in Social Media using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Social media platforms such as Facebook, Twitter, and Instagram drastically change our world. After the Covid-19 outbreak, people become more inclined to discuss their sentiments and emotions on social media. Every year, over 300 million individuals worldwide suffer from depression, a prevalent mental condition that can lead to suicide. Early detection of depression on social media can help save lives. The proposed work aims to identify depressive qualities in tweets. The main challenge of this task is performing feature engineering and modeling to classify tweets as depressed or not. Additionally, estimating both depressive and non-depressive traits in a tweet is essential for fully understanding its content, which is crucial for determining how best to assist the user. We propose a probabilistic machine learning (ML) approach that provides not only a binary classification but also a probability estimate for the classification. This approach allows us to capture the uncertainty and varying degrees of depressive traits in tweets, leading to more nuanced insights. The proposed model is tested using datasets generated from mining depressive tweets and an equal number of random tweets, totaling 39,111 tweets. By improving data collection with precise keywords and enhancing feature engineering through proper tweet cleaning, the proposed model’s accuracy increases by 3%. The probabilistic approach further enhances the model's ability to assess the likelihood of depressive characteristics.

articleTitle: Empirical Evaluation of Building Crack Identification and Classification using Deep Learning Methodology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Background: Structural health monitoring (SHM) is a critical aspect of maintaining the safety and integrity of infrastructure such as bridges, buildings, and roads. Early detection of cracks and other defects is essential to prevent catastrophic failures and to plan timely maintenance and repairs. This study addresses the challenge of robust crack detection and classification in structural health monitoring systems by leveraging a comprehensive dataset and advanced deep learning techniques. Methods: Utilizing the 'DeepCrack' dataset, which encompasses diverse and heavily annotated images of cracks on surfaces like concrete and asphalt under various lighting and atmospheric conditions, we aimed to develop a model that performs reliably across different scenarios. The proposed hybrid model, CrackNet-Hybrid, integrates Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for feature extraction and Support Vector Machines (SVMs) for classification, combining the strengths of deep learning and traditional machine learning approaches. The dataset underwent extensive preprocessing, including normalization, resizing, Gaussian blurring, edge detection, and segmentation, to enhance the model's performance. Data augmentation techniques further increased the robustness of the model by simulating various real-world conditions. Conclusion: CrackNet-Hybrid demonstrated superior performance, achieving an accuracy of 98%, outperforming other models such as ResNet50, VGG16, and AlexNet.

articleTitle: An Individualised Diet Coach Using Ensemble Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: The Personal Nutritionist GUI is a sophisticated diet recommendation system designed to utilize Ensemble Machine Learning techniques for tailoring personalized meal plans based on individual health information. This innovative tool offers users a comprehensive and user-friendly interface to input their specific health data, such as age, weight, dietary restrictions, and fitness goals. Through the utilization of Ensemble Machine learning algorithms, the system analyzes this input data to generate precise dietary recommendations that align with the user's unique nutritional needs and preferences. The GUI provides visual representations of recommended meal options, portion sizes, and nutrient breakdowns, making it easy for users to track their daily intake and make informed decisions about their dietary choices. By integrating cutting-edge technology with individual health profiles, the Personal Nutritionist GUI empowers users to adopt healthier eating habits and achieve their wellness goals efficiently and effectively.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence in Gaming: A Bibliometric Analysis of Research Outputs and Trends
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: This report provides a thorough bibliometric analysis of academic research on artificial intelligence (AI) in gaming, utilizing data obtained from the Scopus database. The analysis reveals noteworthy trends and offers unique insights into the area by analyzing publication numbers, citation impacts, authorship patterns, and geographical distribution. The most notable publication sources are highlighted, with the IEEE Conference on Computational Intelligence and Games (CIG) being the primary venue, followed by CEUR Workshop Proceedings and AAAI Workshop - Technical Report. Documents that have received a significant number of citations, such as those authored by Mnih V (2015) and Vinyals O (2019), are recognized for their pioneering contributions. Renowned writers such as Bulitko V, Togelius J, and Lucas SM are recognized for their significant contributions to the scientific community. The report also shows a significant rise in academic production after 2013, suggesting an increasing fascination and swift progress in the utilization of AI in gaming. The United States has the top position in terms of research contributions, with the United Kingdom and Canada following closely behind, demonstrating a significant global presence. The frequent utilization of terminology such as "artificial intelligence," "human-computer interaction," and "video game" highlights the research's emphasis on technology and user-centeredness. The research also recognizes constraints arising from its sole dependence on the Scopus database, which may result in the exclusion of pertinent papers that are indexed in other prominent databases such as Web of Science and Google Scholar. However, the report provides a comprehensive summary of the present condition and future prospects of AI research in gaming, serving as a basis for further investigation and advancement in this rapidly evolving sector.

articleTitle: A Logical Examination of Roadway Crack Detection and Classification Methodology using Improved Neural Network Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Background: Roadway crack detection is a significant aspect of modern infrastructure management, essential for maintaining road safety and extending the lifespan of roadways through timely maintenance. Cracks on road surfaces can occur due to various factors such as traffic load, environmental conditions, aging, and subgrade settlement. Early detection and proper classification of these cracks are crucial for performing timely repairs, preventing further deterioration, and avoiding costly reconstructions. Traditional methods are time-consuming, labor-intensive, and prone to human error. Methods: This paper presents an improved methodology using Advanced Hybrid Neural Network (AHN-Net) strategies for automated crack detection and classification. High-resolution images of road surfaces are processed using deep learning models to identify and categorize various types of cracks. Results: Our proposed method achieves an accuracy of 97%, significantly enhancing detection precision and efficiency. This approach reduces the need for manual inspections, improving overall road maintenance strategies.

articleTitle: Historical Strategies Flow Detection for Organizations using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Companies hire a wide variety of strategies to attain their enterprise dreams, which could embody diverse elements in their operations. The venture investigates the feasibility of predicting a company’s future profitability using machine studying based on ancient strategic facts. With the emergence of gadget gaining knowledge of and information mining in current years, new thoughts and methods have emerged in the detection of bizarre network flows for monetary statements. This explores the application of device studying techniques, especially random forest and selection tree algorithms, for historic method waft detection in organizations. It targets to increase a robust methodology to research historical statistics and perceive patterns that screen strategic shifts or traits over time. By leveraging random woodland and choice tree algorithms, which are well-perfect for class responsibilities and function selection, the have a look at seeks to offer precious insights for strategic choice-making. The proposed technique involves preprocessing the statistics, choosing applicable functions, and schooling the ML models to come across historical method flows. The outcomes are predicted to beautify underneath-status of ways businesses evolve their strategies through the years, thereby supporting in enhancing strategic making plans and decision-making procedures. The model’s powerfulness is classified on a checking out set to decide its accuracy in forecasting profitability, and discover styles which might be related to future earnings increases. It demonstrates the capability of device getting to know to transport past surely detecting abnormalities in monetary statements. By reading a broader variety of ancient strategic information, the performance won is above 85% to 95%. This deeper information empowers businesses to make informed choices about aid allocation. This approach offers several benefits over traditional forecasting techniques. The version can probably help agencies make knowledgeable choices about aid allocation, R&D, marketing to maximize profitability
