articleTitle: Strategic and Sustainable ERP Decision Framework: Integrating Multi-Criteria Analysis with Deep-A-CNN-LSTM Models in Corporate Strategy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Customizing enterprise resource planning (ERP) software to meet a company's unique operational requirements is a crucial consideration throughout implementation. It offers a framework in this post to help management make decisions about customization choices and the capabilities needed to implement them. This structure allows us to identify several openings for tailoring the ERP system and company processes. A preprocessing step, feature extraction, and training the model make up the three phases of the said approach. The preprocessing steps include extracting summary metrics and performing temporal principal component analysis (PCA). One method for extracting features is Kernel Principal Component Analysis, or Kernel PCA. During the training process, a Deep-A-CNN-LSTM was utilized. With an average accuracy of 92.46%, the suggested method outperforms LSTM and CNN.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of Different DC-DC Converters and Intelligent Controlling Algorithms for Solar PV Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Background: Over the past few decades, there has been a significant increase in the adoption and development of Renewable Energy Sources (RES). Among these, solar power has emerged as the most viable option due to its clean, quiet, and sustainable nature. However, photovoltaic (PV) systems often face challenges such as low stability, sporadic characteristics, and low energy conversion efficiency. DC-DC converters play a critical role in the extraction of electric power from PV systems, making them an essential component of solar energy conversion systems. Methods: This paper reviews several DC-DC converters from both topology and control scheme perspectives. It explores recent controlling strategies aimed at optimizing converter performance, with a focus on enhancing energy conversion efficiency and stability. The study includes an in-depth analysis of various control schemes and their effectiveness when applied to different converter topologies. Results: The findings indicate that artificial intelligence (AI)-based control models are particularly suitable for grid and electric car applications. These AI-based models enable effective regulation of converters by providing appropriate control signals at the right times, leading to improved performance and efficiency. The study compares the effectiveness and performance of various controlling strategies, demonstrating the superiority of AI-based models over traditional methods. Concluding Remarks: This paper highlights the importance of advanced control schemes in optimizing the performance of DC-DC converters in PV systems. The review and comparison of different strategies underscore the potential of AI-based models in enhancing energy conversion efficiency and stability.

articleTitle: Harnessing Emulation Models and Big Data Analytics for Enhanced Business Intelligence and Competitive Edge
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: This research paper investigates the application of advanced emulation models and AI-driven big data analytics to enhance business intelligence and competitive advantage. The study integrates sophisticated analytical methodologies to provide actionable insights for strategic decision-making. The research encompasses three primary emulations: Prognostic Modelling, Sentiment analysis, and Customer Segmentation, each designed to explore different aspects of business operations and decision-making processes. The study examines the impact of prognostic modelling on inventory management and sales forecasting. Model can optimize supply chain operations and improve performance. The study also includes customer segmentation analysis, utilizing clustering algorithms such as K-means, Hierarchical Clustering, and DBSCAN to identify distinct customer segments and their characteristics. This segmentation informs targeted marketing strategies and personalized experiences. Additionally, sentiment analysis models, including VADER and BERT, assess customer perceptions by analyzing reviews and feedback, providing insights into product quality, customer service, and overall satisfaction. The findings reveal that integrating these advanced methodologies significantly enhances business intelligence, enabling organizations to anticipate trends, manage risks, and tailor strategies to meet customer needs. The research underscores the importance of adopting sophisticated data analytics techniques to drive strategic decisions and achieve sustainable competitive advantage.

articleTitle: Prediction of Common Diseases Lurking in Smokers and Alcoholics and its Impact on their Health
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Smoking and alcohol intake have become very common in modern society, leading to many complications and health problems, including respiratory illnesses and cardiovascular diseases. Early intervention and targeted healthcare interventions are very much needed to mitigate these risks and improve patient outcomes. This research addresses the need by using patient data to predict potential future health risks. By analysing 19 health and lifestyle factors, including smoking, alcohol consumption, diabetes, hypertension, haemoglobin and such factors, the study developed a predictive model to identify diseases that patients may currently have or develop in the near future. After extensive hyperparameter tuning and analysis, the study utilized a deep learning model optimized with the ReduceLROnPlateau technique, Adam as the optimizer and binary cross-entropy as the loss function. With the best parameters, including a learning rate of 0.001, 200 epochs, and a batch size of 64, the model achieved the highest accuracy of 94.69%. Additionally, to assess and compare the efficiency of the deep learning model, the study explored Random Forest algorithm due to its robustness in handling complex datasets. Initially focused on smokers and alcoholics, the study expanded to include non-smokers and non-alcohol consumers, demonstrating the model's broad applicability. These findings highlight the model's strong predictive capability and its potential for widespread use in preventive healthcare. Further, the current study uses dashboard visualization that reveals common disorders that affect smokers and drinkers, providing the valuable insights on targeted treatments to improve patient care and outcomes in population.

articleTitle: Sparse Attention Mechanism And Ensemble Strategies On Transformers [Sam-Est] for Detection Of Offensive Comments in Tamil
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: The necessity to develop algorithms that can rapidly recognize and distinguish between offensive and inoffensive comments brings to light the need of identifying offensive comments in Tamil. It is possible to lessen the harmful impacts of online hate speech, such as trolling, cyberbullying, and social and political polarization, by identifying and removing poisonous comments while promoting constructive online discourse. It draws attention to the negative impacts of offensive words on individuals and organizations, including psychological trauma, rifts in society, and even physical violence. The advancement of online dialogue as a whole and the defense of democratic values require the creation of effective models for the detection of hostile remarks.

articleTitle: The Influence of Artificial Intelligence Using Decision Making System in E-Commerce
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: E-Commerce is one of the potential idea and network developments which influence the present business world. It spreads worldwide and reaches people rapidly due to its massive benefits and trading approach. Artificial Intelligence (AI) has become an integral part of the e-commerce industry, providing retailers with new and innovative ways to manage and grow their business. One of AI's key advantages is its capacity to offer tailored product recommendations based on user information including shopping patterns, search terms, and browsing habits. By using AI algorithms to analyze this data, retailers can offer customers relevant product recommendations that are more likely to result in a sale. Automating customer support is a further area where AI is useful. Chatbots that are driven by AI can offer all times, immediate service to customers, increasing their satisfaction and speeding up response times. Retailers may now streamline their customer care procedures and concentrate on other aspects of their businesses thanks to this. By forecasting demand, identifying popular products, and ensuring that the relevant products are in stock at the appropriate moment, AI can assist merchants in streamlining their inventory management procedures. Retailers can lower the risk of overstocking or understocking products, which can result in missed sales and lower profitability, by using AI to manage inventory. Furthermore, AI can be used for fraud detection by analyzing customer behavior, purchase history, and other data points. This helps retailers to prevent fraudulent transactions and reduce chargebacks, which can result in significant financial losses. Finally, by examining competition prices, demand, and other factors, AI can assist businesses in optimizing their pricing strategy. By setting the right price, retailers can maximize profits and increase sales. The Main objective of this work is, using advanced technologies to analyze the Ecommerce data and prediction of sales accurately. Different ML and DL algorithms using this work for E-Commerce analysis and Prediction.

articleTitle: Ensemble Learning: Importance, Applications, Challenges, and Future Work
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Ensemble learning has become one of the most used approaches in machine learning that helps to increase predictive capabilities and model stability. Thus, this survey paper offers an extensive analysis of ensemble learning, stressing its significance, potential uses, inherent difficulties, and future research prospects. In the first step, we explain the basic ideas and the major ensemble approaches, including bagging, boosting, and stacking. We then discuss the flexibility of ensemble learning in classification, regression, and outlier detection problems and its implications in health informatics, finances, e-business, and self-driving systems. However, there are challenges associated with ensemble learning, for example, computational cost, the quality of data used, and the fact that the models themselves cannot be explained. These are the issues that can hinder the performance of ensemble models and the ideas to help to improve the efficiency of this method. In addition, we outline potential future research avenues such as novel ensemble learning methods, optimization of computational complexity, interpretability of models as well as new use cases in emerging fields like IoT, quantum computing, and edge computing. We also highlight the need to consider the ethical issues towards attaining fairness and accountability in ensemble learning. The results of this survey should contribute to raising the base of knowledge about ensemble learning and stimulate further research and development in this actively evolving area.

articleTitle: The Human Resource Management challenge of predicting employee turnover using CNN-BiLSTM Based Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: There is a lot of concern among many organizations and corporations around employee turnover. This is a critical issue since it threatens the longevity of business strategies, company cultures, and jobs. Human resources departments are increasingly concentrating on employee turnover as a means to better understand the underlying factors and causes. This proposed aims to address that gap by creating a new method for predicting employee turnover using an improved random forest algorithm. Strict adherence to this technique is crucial to attain the greatest potential outcomes throughout model training, feature selection, and preprocessing. Among data preparation, one of the numerous stages of data mining is crucial; this section defines the seven most significant elements. A feature selection strategy based on Intensive Optimized Principal Component Analysis (PCA) is suggested. A CNN-BiLSTM was used to train the model. The proposed method outperforms more conventional approaches like CNN and LSTM. The accuracy was enhanced by 92.41% after implementing the technique.

articleTitle: Quantum-enhanced Vehicle Detection and Speed Monitoring using OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Quantum based vehicle detection is the innovative integration of Quantum Machine Learning (QML) techniques with classical computer vision methods to enhance vehicle detection and speed tracking systems using OpenCV. Traditional approaches in vehicle detection and speed tracking are often hindered by computational inefficiencies and accuracy limitations in complex traffic scenarios. Our proposed hybrid quantum-classical framework aims to overcome these complications by exploiting the computational advantages of quantum computing. In this study, we employ Quantum Principal Component Analysis (QPCA) for feature extraction and data dimensionality reduction, optimizing the input data for improved processing efficiency. The core detection mechanism integrates Quantum Neural Networks (QNNs) with classical Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), enhancing the model’s accuracy in identifying vehicles within video frames. For speed tracking, we apply quantum optimization techniques to refine the tracking of vehicle positions across consecutive frames, ensuring precise speed calculation. Using OpenCV for real-time video processing and Qiskit for quantum computations, the findings from the experiments indicate significant improvements in both detection a precision, accuracy and computational efficiency. The hybrid quantum-classical model showcases the potential of quantum computing in advancing computer vision applications, particularly in intelligent transportation systems. This research highlights the transformative impact of QML techniques on practical applications and paves the way for further advancements in quantum-enhanced vehicle detection and speed tracking.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Based Reliable and Delay Aware Routing Scheme for Underwater Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: In this study, a delay-aware, fuzzy-based, dependable routing method for underwater wireless sensor networks (UWSNs) is presented. The emergence of micro-electro-mechanism systems (MEMS) and wireless communication technologies has led to the increasing use of UWSNs in a range of applications, including military observation and natural disaster monitoring. Because of the energy hole phenomena, energy conservation in UWSNs is a major difficulty, especially in the vicinity of static sink nodes. To tackle this issue, the suggested plan incorporates fuzzy logic, enabling adaptable reasoning and managing the uncertainties present in submerged situations. Modules for fuzzification, fuzzy rule creation, defuzzification, and inference make up the fuzzy logic system. The scheme’s capacity to balance energy consumption and mitigate delays is proved through simulations, which ultimately improves the overall dependability of UWSNs. As compared to current approaches, the results show better performance, indicating fuzzy logic’s promise for route optimization in underwater situations.

articleTitle: Enhancing Mortality Prediction in ICU: A Deep Learning Framework for Multivariate Time Series Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Relying on human diagnosis is potentially prone to errors, time-consuming and leading to treatment mistakes. Early Intensive Care Unit (ICU) mortality prediction is important for determining which patients are most likely to die and for offering appropriate interventions that will preserve their lives. However, conventional diagnostic approaches often face challenges in fully harnessing the extensive information contained within Electronic Health Record (EHR) data, particularly in capturing the intricate temporal dynamics of patient health. In this research paper, a hybrid model leverages the power of Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCN) in conjunction with Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Units (BiGRU) to effectively capture the complex temporal dependencies present in ICU time series data, before constructing the model, the data is pre-processed by cutting-edge Generative Adversarial Network (GAN)-based imputation techniques to handle missing values within the EHR data. Through this comprehensive framework, the goal is to significantly enhance mortality prediction accuracy, empower clinicians with actionable insights into patient prognosis, and ultimately improve patient outcomes in critical care settings.

articleTitle: A Multichannel CNN-LSTM Approach for Fake News Detection: A Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: The proliferation of fake news across various language sources poses a significant challenge in ensuring the dissemination of accurate and reliable information. Addressing this issue is crucial for maintaining the integrity of news content and public trust. We developed a novel approach combining Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) for deep feature extraction and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks for subsequent detection of fake news. Our approach utilizes a Multichannel combined CNN-LSTM architecture. We collected an extensive dataset comprising 40,000 unique news articles from diverse sources to evaluate our model. Additionally, we integrated Gaussian and Random Forest models to benchmark performance. Our findings revealed that the LSTM component of the model achieved a remarkable accuracy of 97%, significantly outperforming the CNN's accuracy of 75%. The Gaussian model also recorded an accuracy of 75%, while the Random Forest model matched the LSTM's performance with an accuracy of 97%. The study demonstrates the effectiveness of our hybrid CNN-LSTM approach in detecting fake news, highlighting its potential as a robust tool for combating misinformation. Our results contribute to the growing body of research in fake news detection and underscore the value of leveraging deep learning techniques to enhance the accuracy and reliability of news content.

articleTitle: Pattern-Aware Indoor Semantic Segmentation Based on Visual Optimization Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Semantic segmentation of indoor scenes plays a pivotal role in various applications such as indoor navigation systems, creating detailed and accurate indoor maps, and optimizing route planning for both humans and robots. However, effectively integrating RGB (color) and HHA (depth) images for indoor semantic segmentation poses both promise and challenge due to the diverse textures and structures present in indoor environments, coupled with the varying significance of different modalities. Traditionally, tasks like semantic segmentation and depth estimation have been treated as separate entities in computer vision. However, recent advancements in research have explored the potential benefits of combining these tasks into a unified framework. The rationale behind this exploration lies in the inherent correlation between semantic understanding and depth perception, suggesting that integrating these tasks could lead to more accurate estimations. Our approach diverges from conventional segmentation methods by proposing the integration of two neural network models to achieve precise semantic segmentation specifically tailored for mobile robot mapping applications. Initially, we employ a model to identify salient objects within the scene, which are then delineated in grayscale. Subsequently, the contours of these salient objects, along with their semantic labels, are projected onto the corresponding RGB image, resulting in the segmentation of important objects within the indoor environment. By focusing on salient objects rather than considering the entirety of the scene, our method streamlines the segmentation process, simplifying the consideration of background elements. This targeted approach is particularly advantageous in scenarios where efficient and accurate segmentation of relevant objects is paramount, such as in robotic navigation tasks within complex indoor environments.

articleTitle: Semi-automated Overhead Water Tank Cleaner
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: The traditional methods of cleaning overhead water tanks are labor-intensive, risky, and wasteful, involving manual scrubbing, high-pressure washing, and chemical cleaning, all of which pose significant challenges. The semi-automated overhead water tank cleaner addresses these limitations by integrating advanced mechanisms and automation to enhance efficiency, safety, and water conservation. This system utilizes a universal motor to drive a 6-bar link mechanism with bristles, allowing it to clean tank interiors without complete drainage, thereby reducing water wastage and minimizing health risks associated with manual labor. The cleaner's adaptability to various tank sizes and configurations makes it suitable for residential, commercial, and industrial applications. Results demonstrate that the semi-automated cleaner significantly reduces operational disruptions by streamlining the cleaning process, promoting water conservation, and supporting sustainability. By enhancing efficiency and safety, this innovative cleaner represents a substantial improvement in overhead water tank maintenance practices.

articleTitle: Decentralized File Sharing: Leveraging Blockchain and IPFS for Secure Data Storage
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: The rapid growth in data creation and the demand for secure storage solutions have driven the development of decentralized file-sharing platforms. Traditional centralized systems face issues like single points of failure, data breaches, and censorship, which threaten data integrity. Blockchain, known for its security and transparency, combined with the Inter Planetary File System (IPFS), offers a robust alternative for decentralized file sharing. This research explores how blockchain and IPFS enhance data security, reliability, and efficiency. The system uses blockchain for secure transaction logging, ensuring data immutability and traceability. IPFS provides decentralized file storage by splitting files into chunks, hashing them, and distributing them across nodes. Access is managed through blockchain-based smart contracts, handling authentication and authorization. Performance is evaluated through experiments measuring data retrieval speed, system throughput, and security.Initial results show that integrating blockchain with IPFS significantly improves security and resilience over traditional systems. IPFS ensures high availability and redundancy, while blockchain offers a tamper-proof record of transactions. The system matches centralized systems in data retrieval speed and throughput, with added security and reliability.Blockchain and IPFS offer a promising solution for decentralized file sharing, addressing the shortcomings of centralized systems. This approach enhances data security and integrity and supports data sovereignty.Our key contribution is the implementation of a multi-formatting technique that increases the flexibility and efficiency of data storage and retrieval.

articleTitle: A Resilient Mod Osprey Optimization Algorithm (MOOA) Based Effective Demand Side Management for Solar PV tied Smart Grid Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Background: This paper addresses the challenges of managing demands on solar PV-tied smart grid networks by implementing a specialized optimization technique. The primary aim is to enhance the effectiveness of demand-side management (DSM), thereby optimizing energy use, reducing peak load periods, and achieving a balanced load profile across the smart grid. Methods: The proposed method utilizes a Multi-Objective Optimization Algorithm (MOOA) specifically designed to optimize DSM within smart grid networks. MOOA enhances energy management by planning demand schedules more efficiently, shifting loads to off-peak times, and increasing the use of renewable energy. This optimization technique is capable of adjusting to real-time changes and uncertainties in energy supply and usage, thereby enhancing the resilience and stability of the grid. Results: Simulation analyses reveal that MOOA significantly optimizes energy use, reduces peak load times, and balances the load profile across the smart grid. The integration of solar PV systems contributes to sustainability efforts by decreasing dependence on non-renewable fuels and boosting the use of renewable energy sources. Economic benefits are achieved through cost savings from more efficient demand scheduling and greater utilization of renewable energy. Concluding Remarks: This paper underscores the transformative potential of integrating MOOA-linked DSM and renewable energies into smart grid networks. The findings demonstrate that MOOA effectively enhances DSM, optimizes energy use, reduced costs, and increases grid resilience and stability. The proposed approach offers significant benefits for smart grid networks, including improved efficiency, sustainability, and robustness.

articleTitle: Virtual Reality Tele-Operation System for Mobile Robot Manipulation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: This paper aims to discuss a relatively new area of virtual reality (VR) tele-operation in terms of flexible robot control scenarios that will promote more progressive relations between people and robots. VR tele-operation can be described as encouraging administrators to work on controlling remote portable robots while in a virtual environment. This innovation eliminates dilemmas that involve the relationships human beings have with robots regarding their interaction. Thus, complicated energy and reproduction procedures in VR tele-operation allow natural control to be performed with great accuracy. The possible fields of utilization are immense, ranging from medical services, assembly, synchronized operations, and so on to a great extent. In the medical field, the specialists could do activities such as performing surgery at a distance. Thus, in assembling, laborers had a certain amount of authority over robots in dangerous areas. This paper explores deeper into the core concept of VR teleoperation frameworks to evaluate the frameworks' effectiveness, and the challenges involved in the process, intending to provide a foundation for further research in what is quite an enticing and promising field.

articleTitle: Autonomous Weapon Detection System in Real-Time Monitoring Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Background-This study delves into convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and the TensorFlow Object Detection API. The research utilizes these advancements to retrain a pre-existing model for real-time surveillance weapon detection. Methods- The objective is to examine the impact of training CNNs with an additional class, "non-weapon," alongside the original classes, "gun" and "knife." The goal is to determine if the model's accuracy varies when identifying non-weapon objects. Results- The research findings demonstrated that utilizing an Inception feature extractor enabled the faster R-CNN model to achieve a commendable mean average precision of 95.50% in identifying gun, non-weapon classes and knife. Concluding Remarks- Soldiers are uncomfortable since the temperature is changing daily. Soldiers are affected by severe health issues due to the sudden changes in climate conditions. So, in this work, the body temperature of soldiers and environmental weather states are sensed by using sensors, and based on these sensed values, the body temperature is regulated automatically. The measured parameters are displayed on the mobile screen through the Wi-Fi module NodeMcu, which is interfaced with a temperature sensor and a Peltier module and is the major element in this research.

articleTitle: Enhancing Efficiency and Voltage Gain in EV Charging Systems: Advanced Control of LLC Resonant Converters with ReLyO Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Background: Due to the rise in the usage of electric vehicles (EVs) across the globe, public charging facilities have become a crucial aspect of the transportation industry. The LLC resonant converter is a type of power conversion technology known for its high efficiency, high power density, and flexibility in operating across a wide output voltage range. However, standard LLC resonant converters face issues such as low efficiency at full power and large transformer volume due to broad output voltage specifications. Methods: This paper presents an advanced control model for LLC resonant converters used in EV charging systems, incorporating the Remora Levy Optimizer (ReLyO). This innovative approach addresses the primary issues found in conventional LLC resonant converters. The ReLyO control model enhances voltage regulation and minimizes losses, aiming to achieve high voltage gain and up to 99% efficiency. Results: The proposed ReLyO-controlled converter is thoroughly validated and compared with conventional methods in terms of voltage regulation and loss analysis. The results indicate significant improvements in power conversion efficiency and overall performance. The ReLyO model proves to be effective in advancing the efficiency of EV charging systems, providing a reliable and high-performance charging framework. Concluding Remarks: The research highlights the potential of the ReLyO-controlled LLC resonant converter to modernize existing EV charging systems, accommodating the increasing market scale and growing needs. The findings demonstrate the model's ability to achieve high efficiency and voltage gain, thus contributing to the development of dependable and efficient EV charging infrastructure.

articleTitle: Exploring Voice-Activated AI's Impact on Workplace Productivity with Virtual Assistants
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: This paper presents a revolutionary COMPUTER desktop computer aide encouraged by GPT-3, a cutting-edge language version along with support discovering strategies. The chatbot functioning as a detailed device for COMPUTER individuals, effortlessly incorporates AI to give user-friendly support in jobs varying from standard procedures to progressed data administration and also setups changes. By using the capacities of GPT-3 the chatbot involves individuals in all-natural language discussions, supplying thorough reactions and also carrying out jobs with very little individual input. In addition, an assistance discovering based suggestion system adjusts to individual actions, continually refining ideas to maximize individual experience. This paper likewise represents a substantial innovation in individual computer showcasing the transformative possibility of AI in boosting performance coupled with individualizing the computer experience. With this cutting-edge technique we picture a future where AI-driven individual aides redefine the requirements of customer communication and also effectiveness in COMPUTER procedures.

articleTitle: Detection of Sleep Apnea using Cat Swarm Optimization with TabNet versus CNN Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Sleep apnea is a sleep disease that is often an undetected cause of death. It is generally diagnosed with polysomnography, which can be costly and uncomfortable. To solve this issue, we suggest a website for detecting sleep apnea that uses user-provided data such as the Berlin questionnaire, Epworth Sleepiness Scale (ESS), body measurements, Body Mass Index (BMI), age, and gender. The purpose of this work is to categorize sleep apnea based on the Apnea-Hypopnea Index (AHI) as normal, mild, moderate, or severe. This classification is carried out using a deep learning model, TabNet which suits the best to process the text input. It could be useful for people who feel they have sleep apnea, allowing them to take the essential steps toward a formal diagnosis and therapy. However, this aids in early diagnosis by indicating the stage of the disease, and users are recommended to check with healthcare specialists for a definitive diagnosis. For feature selection, nature-inspired Cat Swarm optimization is applied. The TabNet is trained on a dataset that includes these characteristics as well as the AHI, a common metric for determining the severity of sleep apnea. The algorithm uses these inputs to forecast the likelihood of having sleep apnea: normal, mild, moderate, or severe. The developed TabNet Model is compared with the Convolution Neural Network (CNN) and the results are showcased. To summarize, this approach is a revolutionary technique for sleep apnea detection using Cat Swarm Optimization. It promises to give a more accessible and cost-effective solution for people who feel they have this illness by utilizing user-generated data and deep learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Predicting E-commerce Sales Forecasting and Inventory Management Based on Fuzzy LIM-CNN Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Online shopping's share of the market has grown over the last decade, even if retail as a whole has slowed. Logistical costs for EC are higher than for other retail models due to a variety of problems with inventory management. Even though EC makes inventory management more difficult, it works well with EC because consumers can easily compare prices, which is important because goods demand is very price sensitive. Three stages, including preprocessing, feature selection, and model training, make up this suggested approach. The term "data preprocessing" refers to the steps used to remove any anomalies or noise from the chosen data. Using feature selection, we may sift through different datasets and extract the most unnecessary and superfluous information. A Fuzzy LIM-CNN was employed for the purpose of training the model. The proposed approach outperforms CNN and Fuzzy LIM with an average accuracy of 91.67%.

articleTitle: Wildlife Recognition in Trap Images: Assessing the Efficiency of YOLO Frameworks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Identifying wildlife in their natural habitats is vital for ecological research, conservation, and biodiversity monitoring. Camera traps, which are remotely deployed devices designed to capture images of wildlife with minimal human interference are commonly used tools for this purpose. However, accurately detecting and identifying animals in these images is challenging due to factors such as camera angle, animal pose, background clutter, and lighting conditions. Object detection models, particularly those in the You Only Look Once (YOLO) family, have shown promise in addressing these challenges. YOLO models are known for their balance of speed and accuracy, making them well-suited for real-time applications. This study evaluates the efficacy of three YOLO model versions—YOLOv8, YOLOv9, and YOLOv10 for wildlife detection in camera trap images. The dataset consists of 16,489 images categorized into seven distinct wildlife species. The study aims to provide a comprehensive comparative analysis of these models based on key performance metrics: precision, recall, F1 Score, and mean Average Precision (mAP). The results reveal that YOLOv10 outperforms the other versions, achieving a precision of 0.956, a recall of 0.902, and a mAP of 0.675. These findings suggest that YOLOv10 is highly effective for detecting wildlife in this dataset. The study's results could significantly enhance wildlife monitoring and conservation strategies by improving the automated identification of animals in camera trap images.

articleTitle: Deep Learning with Multi-Modal Imaging: An Advanced Approach to Brain Tumor Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: Brain tumors represents one of the major global health issue, making it crucial to develop advanced and precise detection methods for early diagnosis and effective treatment planning. This research endeavors to advance the field of Brain Tumor detection by integrating deep learning techniques with multi-modal imaging, offering a comprehensive approach that capitalizes on the strengths of various imaging modalities. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have proven to be a promising and powerful tool for automating the detection of brain tumors in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans. Compared to early machine learning models such as Support Vector Machines (SVMs), CNNs offer significant advantages. Random Forests, and k-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) have also been employed for Tumor detection in this context. However, the limitations posed by traditional algorithms like reliance on handcrafted features, limited adaptability to diverse data distributions, and challenges in capturing complex spatial patterns furnishes the necessity for advanced algorithms. The advanced CNNs have revolutionized Brain Tumor detection in medical imaging by automating the process of feature extraction, preserving spatial hierarchies, and enabling accurate and efficient Tumor identification. The different CNN architecture such as CNN with Uncropped lesion, CNN with segmented lesion, CNN with cropped lesion, Deep CNN, 2 Dimensional CNN is examined for detecting tumor. The performance of distinct CNN architectures is compared with traditional methodologies in terms of accuracy, precision and recall. The CNN with uncropped lesion furnishes accuracy of 99% which is around 10% higher than traditional Brain Tumor detection methods.

articleTitle: Improving Diagnosis and Classification of Severity in Diabetic Retinopathy Using Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Integration of Emerging Technologies for the Digital World (ICIETDW)
abstract: One of the most severe consequences of diabetes mellitus is diabetic retinopathy, which causes degeneration of blood vessels in the retina and blindness. The deadly effect of the described disease can be potentially prevented or addressed if detection and treatment measures are undertaken timely. The recent implementation of deep learning (DL) approaches in analyzing massive and complicated data has had a transformative effect of the sphere of medical image analysis. Being capable of recognizing the tiniest features and specifics of the retina, these methods enable highly complicated, efficient detection and classification algorithms. This paper provides a detailed description of the methodology for classifying the level of DR severity using retinal scans from Kaggle. The timeliness of the above response is explained by the urgency of DR detection and treatment measures. It should be noted that a specifically arranged data set was created in the described work, including 2750 pictures in with 5 groups of severity. The maximum training accuracy of 98.55% was reached by using EfficientNetB3 with transfer learning, and the validation and testing accuracies constituted 71.27% and 76.36%, respectively.
